verses.khilasu-dh-dhahabi-fi-sirati-khayri-l-ar: l-ḥamdu lilahi dhī l-'ījādi wa l-qidami mumiddinā biwujūdi l-badri dhī l-qadami
thumma ṣ-ṣalātu wa taslīmun yafūqu ʿalá miskin warandin ʿalá dhī l-faḍli wālqadami
wa ’ālihi l-muhtadīna l-khīrati l-kuramā l-mu'tamī sīrati l-mukhtāri wālqadami
mā arʿada r-raʿdu wālwarqā'u tanḥibu min hadīlihā wa jará damʿun mina l-qalami
wa'innahu idh arāda l-lahu nash'atanā abāna min nūrihi nūra n-nabī l-ʿalami
ina l-ʿawālima ʿālīhā wa sāfilahā ashiʿʿatun ṭalaʿat min afḍali n-nasami
wa'aʿlama l-lahu hādīnā nubūwatahu wa kāna ’ādamu bayna n-nafsi wānnasami
ʿuyūnu l-arwāḥi min nūri l-hudá n-bajasat fa'innahu l-jinsu l-aʿlá maʿdinu s-suṭumi
wakhalqu l-akhlāqi baʿthu l-'anbiyā liẓuhū rihi muqaddimatun fāʿlam wa lā tanami
fī ʿālami l-mulki wāl'arwāḥu tābiʿatun lirrūḥi wāljismi hadhā ghāyatu l-karami
wakāna muḥtajiban min qablu fī ḥujubin yusabbiḥu l-laha fīhā ghayra muttaṣimi
kullu ḥijābin aqāma l-badru min ḥuqubin fīhi liṭāʿati mawlānā bilā sa'ami
wakulluhā ḥāza tasbīḥan yakhuṣṣu bihi ’ātī bitartībihā fī ḥusni muntaẓami
faqudratun minnatun min qablihā ʿiẓamun wa raḥmatun wa saʿādātun limustalimi
karāmatun baʿdahā fī l-ʿaddi manzilatun hidāyatun wa nubūwatun falā tahimi
warifʿatun ṭāʿatu l-mawlá shafāʿatuhu fīhā t-tamāmu lidhā t-tartībi fāḥtakimi
wa qudratin thumma ikrāmin wa maʿrifatin shafāʿatin wahudan jūdin wamin ḥikami
allahi nūrun yakūnu l-lahu mūdiʿahu abā l-wará ṭāhiran fī ṭ-ṭāhiri sh-shiyami
wakāna shīthun waṣīya l-'aṣli muntaqilan min khīratin karamin lilkhīrati l-karami
ḥattá n-tahat bishshumūsi n-nūru muḥtaqiran liqādati l-ʿurbi fihra l-jillati n-nuẓumi
waghayru shīthin famā ta'tīhi munfaridan ḥawwā'u takrīma nūrin ghayri muzdaḥami
yā ghā'iṣa l-baḥri lil'aṣdāfi ʿindiya aṣdāfun bihā durratun aʿlá mina l-jalami
muḥammadun nūru ʿabdi l-lahi shaybata hā shimin waʿabdi manāfin maʿ quṣayyihimi
kilāba murrata kaʿbin wālluwayyi waghā libin wafihrin wamālik naḍrin l-karami
kinānatin wa khuzaymatin wa mudrikatin ilyāsa maʿ muḍari l-ḥamrā'i sirrihimi
ʿaddi nizāran maʿaddan man yujāwizu ʿad nānan fatakdhībuhu qad jā mina l-ʿalami
ḥamla maʿaddin lishāmin armiyā dhakarū idh bukhtu naṣṣara fī tadmīri ʿurbihimi
la'annahum ḥurumāti l-lahi qad hatakū idh qattalū anbiyā'a l-lahi min jurami
idh kāna ḥāmila nūri l-lahi kāna ʿalá ḥifẓi l-'ilahi bilā shakkin walā tuhami
wa qīla fālmalakāni l-ḥāmilāni bihi wadhā ḥadīthu b-ni ʿabbāsin akhī l-ḥikami
wa qīla ʿadnānu fālmaḥmūlu wāliduhu wāl'awwalu l-'aktharu l-'aṣfá mina l-kalimi
wabukhtu naṣṣara idh nīrānuhu khamadat raddū maʿaddan ilá akhwālihi l-karami
wahum baqāyā wulātu l-bayti ḥīna'idhin wazawwajūhu fayā ḥusna kh-tilāṭihimi
lāqá b-na ʿaffāna fī mughīratin wa ʿatīqan ʿinda murrata fārūqan bikaʿbihimi
amā ʿalīyun bilā shakkin qadi l-taqayā bishaybati l-ḥamdi dhī l-'ifḍāli wālhimami
amā l-buḥūru lidhī l-'aṣdāfi fāṣgha ilá tartībihinna tulāqī khayra muntaẓami
fahunna fāṭimatun salmá waʿātikatun ḥubbá wa fāṭimatun hindan lahunna simi
wakhshīyatun bintu shaybānin wamāwiyatun bilwāwi salmá walaylá ʿudda lam tulami
minhunna jandalatun lā tansa ʿātikatan wa barratun thumma bintu s-saʿdi dhī l-karami
salmá walaylá rabābun sawdatun wamuʿā natun wamahda duʿi l-'abyāta taghtanimi
āminatun bintu wahbin ibni ʿabdi manā fi ibni zuhrata ummu l-muṣṭafá l-ʿalami
ibni kilābin waqul fīhi n-tisābuhumā ʿātikatun qīla hindun ummu wahbihimi
waghayra dhalika qālū kāna sayyida qaw mihi kamā jā'anā fardan liʿaṣrihimi
wa barratun ummuhā ay ummu ’āminatin ummu ḥabībin fa'ummu l-barrati l-karami
wa barratun bintu ʿawfin ummu ummi ḥabībin lā tazal dā'iman fī l-baḥthi wa l-himami
wa fī quṣayyin liqā'u l-muṣṭafá maʿa bar ratin wa ummi ḥabībin bittifāqihimi
wa barratun bintu ʿawfin wālliqā'u ʿalá kaʿbin waḥarrir walā tuḍiʿ liḥaqqihimi
tarāhu fī kulli taqdīrātihi nasaban ṣarīḥa fihrin qurayshin min khilāṣihimi
lilahi darru l-ladhī qad qāla mādiḥahu jazāhu mawlāhu khayran ghayra munṣarimi
fālʿurbu khayru unāsin thumma khayruhumu qurayshuhum wahwa fīhim khayru khayrihimi
wa barratun bintu ʿawfin ummuhā fa'umay matun qilābatu ummu hadhihi gh-tanimi
wa dabbatun ummuhā qul ummu dabbata lubná ha'ulā arbaʿun min ghayri fihrihimi
yā wayla abrahatin ḍallat makīdatuhu idhmā yasūqu fuyūlan qāṣida l-ḥarami
wafī'alam taramā yashfī ṣ-ṣudūra liman ʿarā lahu ẓama'un fī ʿilmi ḥālihimi
waʿabdu muṭṭalibin lāqāhu sā'ilahu jimālahu wahwa fī nūrin libadri timi
waqāla min baʿdi mā awlāhu makrumatan ḥaṭaṭta nafsaka yā mawlá ʿani l-ḥurami
lawlā sa'alta ḥimá baytin bihi sharufat ’ābā'uka l-ghurru bayna l-ʿurbi wālʿajami
waqāla lilbayti rabbun sawfa yaḥfaẓuhu ʿaẓīma qawmika lā abghī siwá naʿamī
ḥunāṭatun kharra maghshīyan wakhāra khuwā ra th-thawri ḥīna ranā lilwajhi fī raghami
wasājidun fīluhu l-mubyaḍḍu ḥīna ra'á nūra n-nabīyi waqablan kāna lam yanami
qāla s-salāmu ʿalá n-nūri l-munīri badā yā ʿabda muṭṭalibin fī ẓahrika l-karami
wa’āba yadʿū ilaha l-bayti mubtahilan an yamnaʿa l-bayta ʿan aʿdā'ihi l-'uthumi
raqā thabīran qalīlan thumma qāla alā ūbū lanā ẓ-ẓafru ḥaqqan jā mina l-ḥakami
famā s-tadārat hilālan qawmi ghurratunā illā lanā l-fawzu yā waylan limujtarimi
maḥmūduhu fa'abū l-ʿabbāsi kunyatuhu fafī l-mughammasi ya'bá l-qaṣda lilḥarami
ʿalayhimu arsala r-raḥmānu ḥīna ataw ṭayran abābīla tarmīhim mina l-'irami
wamakhzanu n-nūri lammā ’āba abrahatun wa khayyaba l-lahu ẓannan aqbaḥa r-rajami
ra'á manāman ʿaẓīman qā'iman faziʿan waqīla in ṣadaqat ru'yāka fābtasimi
layukhrijanna ilāhī minka man tabiʿat lahu l-khalā'iqu min jinnin wamin nasami
waqad tazawwaja qālū baʿdu fāṭimatan tashammalat bi'abī l-hādī ilá n-niʿami
lakinna dhalika fī l-mashhūri mumtaniʿun taṣwīruhu rājiʿan mā jā'a fī n-nuẓumi
waʿabda kaʿbata jā'at minhu ʿabda manā fin maʿ zubayrin waʿabdi l-lahi khayrihimi
umaymatan barratan bayḍan waʿātikatan arwá ashiqqā'a ʿabdi l-lahi fāghtanimi
waḥāza jurhumu bayta l-lahi rāziqinā min baʿdi nābitin l-'aṣfá mina r-raḥimi
waqul khuzāʿatu bazzū makkatan ghalaban min baʿdi taslīṭi naghfin fī unūfihimi
waqīla bal sallaṭa l-lahu r-ruʿāfa ʿalayhim kāna idh jā'a fī ifnā'i jullihimi
wabi'ru zamzama ʿamrun ṭammahā ḥasadan idh akharajūhu lijawrin kāna fī l-ḥarami
wafīhi yajʿalu aʿlāqan yuḍannu bihā wa qāma yunshi'u yashkū shiddata l-'alami
ina l-khuzāʿata mā zālū yalūna ilá an jā quṣayyun ḥulaylan khāṭiba l-karami
ḥubbá waqad nāla min tazwījihā niʿaman abnā'a aʿlayna aqmāran liqawmihimi
baʿda ḥulaylin quṣayun qāma mujtahidan li'an yalī l-'amra fihrun akramu l-quthami
hammū ilá ḥafri ’ābārin wa mā q-taṣarū li'an ra'á mā ra'á ḥammālu kallihimi
ru'yāhu fī ṭaybatin maḍnūnatin wa zumā zimin wabarrata min uʿjūbati l-ḥakami
lammā s-tabāna wazāla r-raybu amma ilá izālati ṭ-ṭammi dhā jiddin bilā yatami
min bayni farthin wa dammin ʿinda qaryati namlin ʿinda naqri ghurābin bayyini l-ʿaṣami
rāma sh-tirākan bihi l-'aqwāmu min ḥasadin lammā badā ṭayyu ismāʿīla aṣlihimi
nabʿu l-furāti ladá markūbihi ḥakamun min baynihim aʿdalu l-ḥukkāmi kullihimi
ra'á l-ghazālayni baʿda l-ḥafri min dhahabin wa'adruʿan wasuyūfan fī kh-tiṣāmihimi
wakāna sāsānu aw sābūru muhdiyahā likaʿbati l-lahi jalla l-lahu dhū l-karami
faqāla jī'ū bi'aqdāḥin kaʿādatinā faman lahu kharajat ya'khudh walam yaḍimi
ithnāni lilbayti thumma th-nāni lī walakum ithnāni ayḍan fana'tī akbara ṣ-ṣanami
ḥāza l-ghazālayni baytu l-lahi thummata mā baqá lishaybata min dūni sh-tirākihimi
wa'aṣlaḥa l-bāba bāba l-bayti zayyanahu bidhalika dh-dhahabi l-madhkūri dhā himami
wakāna nādhira nadhrin idh humu j-tamaʿū ʿalá adhīyatihi min shiddati l-'aḍami
fanāla mā rāma min mawlāhu ʿashrata abnā'in yuʿīnūnahu fī l-qitli wa l-khidami
waqad takarrara baʿda n-nayli ru'yatu man yaqūlu awfi l-ladhī ʿāhadta wāʿtazimi
fāghtamma ghamman shadīdan jāmiʿan bihimi musāhiman khārijan bilwālidi l-karami
wa amma naḥwa isāfin thumma nā'ilatin murīda īfā'i dhāka n-nadhri wālqasami
qālūhu qālūhu lā tafʿal bidhā abadan kay lā yurá ʿādatan fī fihra lam tarimi
namḍī likhaybara fīhā shayba kāhinatun musta'mirīna bimā qālat dhawī salami
qālat fakam diyatun kuntum tadūna bihā qālū lahā ʿashratu l-’ābāli min naʿami
qālat lahum fārjiʿū lil'ahli min ʿajalin wasāhimūhu bihā tarḍaw mina l-ḥakami
ini l-qidāḥu ʿalá maḥbūbikum kharajat zīdū fazīdū wazīdū dūnamā sa'ami
ḥattá idhā mā ʿalayhā s-sahmu qad kharajat faltanḥirūhā fa'inna l-laha dhū l-karami
walam yazla dāʿīan mawlāhu mubtahilan aw farraja l-lahu mā yaghshāhu min ghumami
lammā ilá l-mi'ati l-'ajmālu qad waṣalat ḥalla l-qidāḥu ʿalayhā fiʿlu muḥtakimi
min baʿdi ḍarbin thalāthan kāna nāḥirahā musawwiya n-nāsi wa l-'awḥāshi min laḥami
lam taʿdu tilka l-ʿishāra l-kūma inna fidā ahu fidā'u dhawī l-'īmāni kullihimi
thānī dh-dhanbīḥayni ismāʿīlu qāla bidhā n-nāsibū dh-dhabḥi ʿinda t-turbati l-karami
waqīla isḥāqu hadhā qawlu man nasabū dh-dhabḥa fī īliyā nahja l-hudá s-taqimi
waʿabdu muṭṭalabin min baʿdu marra ilá fatāti zuhrata dhāti l-majdi wālkarami
maran ʿalá m-ra'atin tudʿá bifāṭimatin tabghī l-mamāla ilayhā wahya lam turami
waḥāza idh dhāka ʿabdu l-lahi sayyidunā ḥadwan ilá l-khayri nāfī ḍ-ḍayri wānniqami
likay yuṣayyrahā ṣadfan lidurratihi amīnatan naqiyat ʿan sā'iri t-tuhami
waqīla zawwajahā wahbun waqīla wu haybun ʿammuhā wamurabbīhā biḥijrihimi
wahya ḥīna'idhin aʿlá n-nisā sharafan wa nisbatan wāftikhāran min judūdihimi
fī sh-shiʿbi yawma th-thinā l-mukhtāra qad ḥamalat waqāla sahlu b-nu ʿabdi l-lahi dhū l-wadhami
layla l-ʿarūbati ḥalla d-duru fī rajabin thumma l-munādī yunādī musmiʿa l-fahimi
tanabbahū anna nūra l-khatmi laylakumu qad ḥalla fī khīmatin min aṭhari l-khiyami
an ʿaṭṭirū bakhkhirū khayra l-bukhūri wa'afri shū s-sajādāti takrīman ʿalá l-qudhami
qāla l-malā'iku abwābu s-samā futiḥat kadhā l-jinānu wanūru sh-shamsi fī l-ʿiẓami
wa'anna ranna l-laʿīnu l-khabbu yaḥḍuruhu junūduhu wahwa riʿdīdun mina s-sadami
waqāla waylakumu yā ummatī ḥumilat fī hadhihi durratun min aḥsani t-tuwami
wajā'a ’ādamu tabshīran washītu lahā idrīsu nūḥun wahūdun wālkhalīla simi
thumma dh-dhabīḥu kalīmu l-lahi kilmatuhu min awwali sh-shahri fī t-tartībi lā tahimi
ʿalá n-nabī waʿalayhim ajmaʿīna salā mā rabbinā dā'iman ʿamman biṣaḥbihimi
wamāta ḍīqun mina n-niswāni min asafin ʿarafna dhāka mina l-kuhhāni lā tahimi
fayā lahā laylatan gharrā'a qad nukisat fīhā l-kanā'isu wāl'aṣnāmu min raghami
wa qad talāqat wuḥūshu l-khāfiqayna kamā sawākinu l-baḥri qad lāqat mina n-nuʿami
sarīru kulli malīkin ṣāra muntakisan bilā khilāfin warabbi l-kaʿbati l-ḥarami
qaḍá bi'abwā'a ʿabdu l-lahi ḥīna maḍá shahrāni lilḥamli hadhā ashharu l-kalimi
wa qīla fī ṭaybatin qad kāna madfanuhu fī dāri tābiʿatin fāḥdhar mina l-wahami
tābiʿatan ḍabbaṭa z-zurqāni wālḥalabī bittā'i fawqu waʿaynin ghayri munʿajimi
yurwá binūnin waghaynin baʿdu muʿjamatin min ghayrin ʿazwin walā ḍabṭin siwá l-qalami
qul tārikun khamsata l-'ajmāli jāriyatan sayfan kadhā wariqun maʿ qiṭʿati l-ghanami
waʿudda shuqrāna min matrūki wālidihi wa ummuhu tarakat dāran bishaʿbihimi
wa min khadījata dāran bilḥajūni ḥawá khayru l-barīyati min ʿurbin wamin ʿajami
waqāla l-amlāku rabba l-khalqi sayyidanā yabqá nabīyuka maʿdūdan mina l-yutumi
waqāla lā innanī lā shakka ḥāfiẓuhu warabbuhu ʿawnuhu kāfīhi fī l-'imami
min baʿdi mā qad khalā wāwun yuqālu lahā hā anti ḥummilti badran sayyida l-'umami
qūlī uʿīdhu lahu min sharri dhī ḥasadin bilwāḥidi ṣ-ṣamadi l-mawṣūfi bilqidami
wakullu mā liqurayshin dabba qad naṭaqat biḥamli khayri ʿibādi l-lahi kullihimi
fāḥḍarrati l-'arḍu wa l-'ashjāru qad ḥamalat fasummiya l-ʿāmu ʿāma l-fatḥi wārrafami
walinnisā adhina r-raḥmānu ḥamla dhukū ri dhalika l-ʿāma ikrāman limuḥtarami
jabá l-hudá thumma ba'wan wālbahā abadan ḥamlun bikhayri l-wará l-mukhtāri dhī l-qidami
ina l-bashā'ira mā zālat tubashshiruhā ḥattá anāra nawāḥī sh-shāmi littahima
ṭulūʿuhu wa ṭulūʿu l-mushtarī q-taranā yā saʿda muqtabisin min nūrihi l-ʿamami
lammā atāhā l-ladhī ya'tī n-nisā'a ra'at janāḥa ṭayrin nafá mā hāla min jusumi
washammatathā n-nisā'u z-zāhirātu sanan tashmītahā l-mala'u l-'aʿlá dhawū l-karami
wamā ra'at sittunā z-zahrā'u ’āminatun mina l-ʿajā'ibi fāttaʿdīda lā tarumi
waqad ra'at niswatan qad qulna ’āsiyatun wabintu ʿimrāna tīki l-ḥūru lā takimi
ra'at thalāthata aʿlāmin qadi n-taṣabat fī kaʿbatin mashriqin wālmaghribi r-tasimi
tāllahi mā khiftu taḥnīthan ʿalá qasamī sharwāhu mā ḍammahu l-'aṣdāfu min tuwami
waqad atá qawmahā sh-shafā'u shāfiyatan ṣudūra man muniḥū t-tawfīqa fī l-qidami
wa'idh atá kāna masrūran yuqālu wa makḥūlan kamā kāna makhtūnan bilā alami
wa'akhrajathu naẓīfan mā bihi qadharun lim lā wamin ṭībihi t-taṭhīru lissuṭumi
yūmī s-sabābata miqbāḍan aṣābiʿahu mithla l-musabbiḥi yarnū l-ʿulwa dhā himami
jalāla rabbin rafīʿin qāla ḥīna atá waqīla sabbaḥa fī takbīri dhī l-ʿiẓami
wara'suhu jā'a min yumnin wamin ʿibarin adhnāhu ʿaynā ḥabībi l-lahi min ratami
waqul mina dh-dhikri wāttasbīḥi thumma riḍan lisānuhu shafatāhu l-wajhu fāghtanimi
amnun shifā'un thawābun thumma maymanatun ḥilmun wa saʿdun libadrin nayyirin ʿamami
waqad tawālat ʿalá l-’āfāqi wāttaṣalat bushrá l-hawātifi fī mīlādihi l-karami
kharrat limawlidihi l-'awthānu wānbaʿathat thawāqibu sh-shuhbi tarmī l-jinna birrujumi
tazalzalat usṭuwānātu l-mulūki kakaʿ batin thalāthata ayyāmin falam taqumi
mālat mamīlan maʿa l-'arkāni aw sajadat taʿẓīma mustawjibi t-taʿẓīmi muḥtarami
wafī l-wilādati minhu l-jafnatu n-falaqat wālinfilāqu ʿujābun ʿinda qawmihimi
wālmūbidhānu ra'á l-’ābāla qā'idatan khaylan ʿirāban tajūbu d-dijla bilkhadhami
ʿabdu l-masīḥi saṭīḥan jā'a sā'ilahu mujībahu wahwa qad awfá ʿalá sh-shabimi
sayamlikūna yadun minhum akhī malikan mithla sh-shurāfāti lam yakhṭa' mina l-kalimi
ḥamlu l-ʿaṣā sunnatun lil'anbiyā'i maʿan kun ḥāmilan yā b-na mīmin tan'a min shaḥami
bi'ithri khamsīna ʿāma l-fīli qad ṭalaʿat saʿdu s-suʿūdi lidhī saʿdin dujá ẓ-ẓulami
wakāna mīlāduhu mīlāda ikhwatihi wadhāka ʿinda ṭulūʿi l-ghafri kāna numī
min baʿdi ʿishrīna linnaysāni jā'a lanā saʿdun wafawzun waghunmun khayrun mughtanami
waqad maḍá li'anūsharwāna qul yalabun fī ḥifẓi l-askandarī th-thānī akhī l-ḥarami
waman yaqul fahwa dhū l-qarnayni qad ghaliṭū lisabqihi mūminan billahi dhī l-qidami
wa'anna dhalika tilmīdhun li'arsaṭaṭā līsin wafī l-kahfi baḥthu l-'awwali l-karami
kāna b-nu khālatihi fī jayshihi khaḍirun wa fī nubūwatihi khulfun mina l-qudumi
wafī wilāyatihi aw kawnihi malakan qul innahu ṣāliḥun tuṣdaq watuḥtarami
waqul mina l-bidaʿi l-mustaḥsanāti qiyā mun ʿinda dhikri ṭulūʿi sh-shamsi lam taghimi
wa'innahu fī r-rabīʿi l-'awwali n-tasharat fī ḥubbihi wājifātu sh-shawqi lissadimi
ḥaká l-quḍāʿīyu ijmāʿan ʿalayhi naʿam lakinnamā l-'awwalu l-mashhūru lā tahimi
qālū nahāran walaylan qīla dhalika maʿmūlun limakkata ayḍan fāʿtabir waqumi
wajāmiʿun dhaynika l-qawlayni qīla budī laylan watatmīmuhu fī l-fajri fāstaqimi
waḥalla ʿusfāna aw dāra b-ni yūsufa aw fī sh-shiʿbi sayyidunā l-hādī awi r-radami
man ʿaqqa ʿanhu bishātin yawma sābiʿihi fajadduhu sh-shaybatu l-maḥmūdu dhū l-ḥakami
warannatan ranna iblīsun limawlidihi waḥīna ihbāṭihi wa l-laʿni wārrajami
wahakadhā ranna ayḍan ḥīnamā nazalat ummu l-kitābi ʿalá khayri l-wará l-ḥakami
wamā maḍá ḥīna ḥamlin fī wilādatihi ayḍan laqad jā'a kāttankīsi liṣṣanami
min baʿdi wālidati l-mukhtāri arḍaʿahu thuwaybatun labana l-masrūḥi dhī l-ḥarami
ʿawātikun kunna abkāran ḥalīmatu ukhrá ʿindahā min banī saʿdin dhawī l-karami
wa'ummu farwata ammā ummu aymana khaw latun washaymā'u hunna l-khāḍinātu simi
wafī surūri l-ghiná an kullu murḍiʿatin khayra l-barīyati kānat min dhawī s-salami
murāḍiʿūhu faʿabdu l-lahi ḥamzatu masrūḥun thuwaybatu aghnathum mina l-ghudhami
shaymā wa’āsiyatun ʿabdu l-'ilahi abū sufyāna min binti saʿdin naylu saqyihimi
wamā warā dhāka mā qad ṣaḥḥa kulluhumu qad aslamū ghayra masrūḥin falam yaqumi
mā qālahu awwalan fa l-lahu akbaru lalhumma r-rafīqa binaṣbin ’ākhira l-kalimi
lahu badā fī b-tidā'i l-'amri maʿdilatun lilahi ʿadlun badā fī tālika l-'umami
jará nizāʿun kabīrun fī kafālatihi wabilḥalīmati khaṣṣa l-qadru fī l-qidami
famā yuʿaddu walā yuḥṣá l-ladhī laqiyat fatātu saʿdin mina l-’āyāti wāl'imami
atānuhā sabaqat mā dhāka ʿādatuhā wajā'ati l-bidʿa shātu l-jadbi wāl'izami
shabābuhu mā ghulāmun shabbahu abadan wālyawmu shahrun waʿāmun shahru dhī l-karami
ḥabā bishahrayni fī l-jīmi l-qiyāmu wafī dālin ghadā mumsika l-jidrāni dhā himami
waqudratu l-mashyi fī hā'in wa'asraʿa fī wāwin wafī z-zāyi yasʿá saʿya muḥtazimi
fī ḥā takallama fī ṭā'in faṣāḥatuhu fī l-yā'i yarmī wayuʿyī abṣara l-jusumi
min qabli ʿāmayni jafran kāna dhā adabin lilahi darru adībin shabba fī l-yutumi
taqabbala r-ra'sa shātun fī shuhūdi ḥalīmatin waqad sajadat wallat ilá l-ghanami
abūhu ansha'a min shukrin bithāniyatin alḥamdu lilahi rabbī l-wāhibi n-niʿami
wabaʿda ʿāmayni wāshshahrayni shuqqa lahu ṣadrun wafī l-baʿthi wāl'isrā'i lishshalami
waṣadruhu khatamat yumná l-'amīni falam yufsha l-ladhī fīhi khatman ghayra muttathimi
li'ummihi ʿāma khamsin rudda sayyidunā karaddihi qablu ḥīna sh-shaqqi min za'ami
lakinnahu raddahu fī dhāka ’āminatun liẓẓi'ri mimmā tuqāsī minhi min alami
waʿāma arbaʿatin aw sittatin halakat ummu n-nabīyi bi'abwā'in awi z-zuḥami
kānat turīdu ilá l-'akhwāli zā'iratan wafī l-'iyābi l-qaḍā ’ātin mina l-ḥakami
ḥaká s-suyūṭīyu nayla l-maʿdinayni najā tan lā tuḥil qawlahu wāllahu dhū l-karami
li'anna rabbaka mā bilʿajzi muttaṣifun wadhā akhaffu mini n-shā'in mina l-ʿadami
wa'ummu aymana baʿda l-'ummi taḥmiluhu lijaddihi shaybati l-ḥamdi r-riḍá l-ʿaẓimi
fī sābiʿi l-ʿāmi wālhādī atāhu bihi fayā lahu ramadun fī shiddati l-'alami
hudī ilá rāhibin ṭabbin yaqūlu lahu dawā'uhu rīquhu fārjiʿ ilá l-ḥarami
wāljaddu fī l-ʿāmi yamshī libni dhī yazanin likay yuhanni'ahu fī l-mulki wāl'imami
ahdāhu jammā wabilmarḍīyi bashsharahu bi'aṣdaqi l-qawli ṣidqan ghayra muttahami
kamā ghadā fīhi yastasqī muṣāḥibahu min ajli ru'yan warabī wāhibu l-yutumi
ʿāma th-thamānī wafātu l-jaddi dhā hanamin waḥātimin wa'anū sharwāna dhī l-karami
fīhi ghadā lijanibi l-ʿammi ʿabdi manā fin min waṣīyati jaddin mushfiqin raḥimi
fī ḥubbihi ʿammuhu qad rāḥa maʿhu ilá shāmin li'an balaghā buṣrá dhaway ʿiṣami
lammā ra’āhum baḥīrā qāma yukrimuhum wakāna laysa yubālī fī murūrihimi
takhallafa l-badru ʿanhum fī riḥālihimi faqāla fādʿūhu fāttakhlīfu lam yaqumi
faqāma minhum fatan īyāhu muḥtaḍinan waqā'ilan inna dhā lu'mun maʿa l-qazami
lammā ra’āhu baḥīrā qāma yalḥaẓuhu laḥẓan shadīdan wanaẓẓāran ilá l-'imami
wa qāma yas'aluhu wa l-badru sayyidunā yunīru tilka d-dayājī ghayra muʿtatimi
lammā taḥaqqaqa mā qad ẓanna qāla liʿammihi r-dudanhu fa'ahlu l-makri fī himami
waqul zubayrun waʿabbāsun ilá yamanin sārā bihi ʿāma jīdin ʿudda wāḥtakimi
khayru l-wará shāhidun yawma l-fijāri lahu iḥdá waʿishrūna ʿāman laytha muṣṭadami
wahakkadhā shahida l-hādī sh-shafīʿu lanā ḥilfa l-fuḍūli l-ladhī min ashrafi dh-dhimami
ina b-na judʿāna kāna l-ḥilfu manzilahu bimaṭli dayni l-yamānī munshi'a l-kalimi
waʿāma khamsin waʿishrīna r-rujūʿu ilá shāmin wamaysuratun fī khidmati l-karami
ra'á l-ʿajā'iba irkhā'a l-ghuṣūni lahu iẓlālahu fī sh-tidādi l-ḥarri birrakami
qadi sh-ra'abba ilayhi rāhibun huwa nasṭūrā yaqūlu nabīyun jā'a bil'umami
wabaʿda shahrayni fī dhā l-ʿāmi thummata khamsatin wa ʿishrīna yawman dūna muttahami
khadījatun ḍammahā biljazli ḥā'izatan ḥayātahā ghayrahā l-mukhtāru lam yakumi
inan ṣ-ṣaḥīḥa l-ladhī l-jumhūru fīhi maʿan inkāḥuhā fī yahī min dūnimā wadhami
ina l-muzawwija qālū l-ʿammu qīla akhū hā qīla wāliduhā sakrāna min ithami
ʿalla th-thanlāthata dhāka l-ʿaqda qad ḥaḍarū lidhalika l-fiʿlu mansūbun likullihimi
hindun tazawwajahā min qablihi waʿatīqun qīla bilʿaksi jalla l-lahu dhū l-karami
wasayyidu l-shuhadā'i l-ʿaqda shāhiduhu sawwāqu l-aʿdā'i sawqa l-ajdali l-ḥuṭami
amā l-khaṭību lahu fālʿammu kāfiluhu inna n-nabīya lasaʿdun l-'ahli wālʿamami
ṣadāquhā kāna kāfan bakratan wayuqā lu ghayru dhā fākhtilāfun ḥilfu nahjihimi
wabiljazūri rasūlu l-lahi awlamahā nafīsatun fadasīsun ghayru muttahami
imā'ahā amarat birraqṣi min ṭarabin famā lahā yā lahā fī dhāka min ithami
qabla n-nisā ṣadaqat awlāduhu kharajū minhā siwá l-badri ibrāhīma dhī l-wadhami
wāl'ummu māriyatun law ʿāsha fāza bihi alqibṭu fawzan ʿaẓīman ghayra munṣarimi
ʿāma th-thalāthīna baʿda l-khamsi qad ḥaḍara l-binā'a ḥattá banat kaffāhu bilʿalami
wāsmu l-ladhī qad baná l-bayta l-ʿaẓīma lahum bāqūmu bilmīmi aw billāmi fāftahimi
waḥakkamathu qurayshun idh humu kh-talafū fī r-rafʿi fī yawmihi yaqḍī qaḍá l-ʿalami
min baʿdi ṭā'in walāmin thumma sittati ashhurin ra'á kānfilāqi ṣ-ṣubḥi lam yahimi
wāllahu arsalahu lilʿālamīna hudan waraḥmatan idh maḍá jazlun bilā wahami
fī yawmi l-ithnayni fī sh-shahri l-muʿaẓẓami idh li'ibrawīza maḍá l-ʿishrūna min amami
wakāna bad'an ʿalá ḥubbi l-khalā'i ilá an jā'a fī l-ghāri rūḥu l-qudsi lam yanami
waghaṭṭahu libulūghi l-jahdi qā'ilahu fāqra' waqāla lahu mā dhāka min nuẓumī
wa’āba murtaʿidan mimmā yará faziʿan waqā'ilan zammilūnī tarfaʿū ghumamī
khadījatun sakkanat bilqalbi qā'ilatan lam yukhzika l-lahu fī d-dārayni lā takimi
jā'at lawarqata taḥkī mā rawāhu lahā waqāla nāmūsu mūsá dhāki fābtasimī
yā laytanī kuntu fīhā sāliman jadhaʿan wakuntu ḥayyan ladá l-'ikhrāji lil'iḍami
khudh ʿadda mānazala r-rūḥu l-'amīnu ʿalá ruslin urattibu kay ujzá binaẓmihimi
yabun li’ādama nūnun thumma tā falinū ḥin thumma mūsá li'ibrāhīma ʿaddu bami
dālun li'idrīsa ʿīsá ḥāza yā ʿadadan walilḥabībi kadun alfan falā tahimi
mā zāla ya'tī lahu jibrīlu ʿadda yajī mina s-sinīna bi’āyātin mina l-ḥakami
min baʿdihi nāzilun yā'an fayarfaʿu yā fī rafʿihā qul fasādu l-khalqi wa l-quḥami
yumnun waḥubbun warakhmun maʿdilun waḥayā ṣabrun wazuhdun sakhā l-qur’ānu bissalami
ru'yā khiṭābun kadhā l-'ilqā'u min malaka marātibu l-waḥyi lā tartab walā tahimi
waqad ʿará l-waḥyu ḥaqan baʿdu maftaratun mīman wakāna r-riḍá fī ghāyati l-wakami
yaʿlū l-jibāla murīdan ramya juththatihi ḥuznan ilá l-'arḍi lawlā r-rūḥu dhū r-rakhami
wabaʿda dhā anzala r-raḥmānu khāliqunā yā ayyuhā habba yadʿū mundhira l-ʿuzumi
khadījatun waʿalīyun wābnu ḥārithatin waman bidaʿwatihi ʿuthmānu dhū salami
thumma b-nu ʿawfin wasaʿdun wāzzubayru waṭalḥatun kaʿuthmāna fī l-'islāmi wāl'imami
waʿāmirun wasaʿīdun maʿ ʿubaydata ʿabdu l-lahi ʿammāru subbāqun ilá l-karami
wakāna daʿwatuhu sirran thalātha sinīna yā lahu ʿinda dāri l-'arqami l-khadhimi
watuddaʿá l-’āna dāra l-khayzurāni waṣaḥbuhu ʿalá wajali l-lahi rabbihimi
walā yuṣallūna illā fī sh-shiʿābi idhā mā sh-tadda ʿusrun fayusru l-lahi fī amami
wa'innahum kharajū min baʿdi kawnihimu zujlan wakāna shihābu d-dīni dhā ḍarami
wabinnabī aslama l-fārūqu thumma bihi kāna l-khurūju linaḥwi l-masjidi l-ḥarami
wazāra dhullaun waḥuznun yā unkhayya qurayshan mā yaẓunnūna anna l-'amra dhū l-wadhami
ka'an bihi maraḍun lammā atāhu wa'andhiri l-ʿashīrata yā mukhtāru min rajami
ʿammātuhu qulna fāṭlub liljamīʿi walā tadʿū abā lahabin dhā l-ḥiqdi wlkazami
daʿā l-jamīʿa likay ya'tū ilayhi maʿan mukarriran anqidhū l-'arwāḥa min ḥuṭami
amā abū lahabin tabban ajāba lidhā tabbat yadā nazalat mā zāla dhā sadami
idh anzala l-lahu fāṣdaʿ qāma mujtahidan wajāhiran biduʿā'i n-nāsi kullihimi
wadhāka fī sannatin qad qīla rābiʿatin mustahzi'īhi wamūdhī kulli mustalimi
wabaʿda sabbin wataḍlīlin watasfihatin akhfaw lahu kullamā akhfawhu min aḍami
ashaddu ḍurran mina l-'aʿdā abū lahabin wāl'aswadāni walīdun ḥārithun bihimi
naḍrun zuhayrun abū qaysin nubayhu munabbihun waʿuqbatu wālʿāṣi abū l-ḥakami
wamuṭʿimun wa'unbayun maʿ rukānata mā likun umayyatu ahlu l-baghyi wālqazami
mustaḍʿafūna bilālun ʿāmirun waṣuhaybun aflaḥun yāsirun maʿ ’ālihi l-karami
aʿnī sumayyata ʿabda l-lahi thummata ʿammāran kadhalika miqdādu b-ni ʿamrihimi
khabbābu ummu ʿubaysin maʿ lubaynata zinnīrun wanahdīyatun mawlātu nahdīhimi
fahijratan adhina l-mukhtāru fī rajabin liḥabshatin ʿāma khamsin ṭālibī s-salami
radda l-ʿatīqu ladá barki l-ghimādi jiwā ra ḥārithin faʿatīqun khayru mustalimi
tawajjahū linnajāshī l-baḥra qad rakibū bā'an wayā rajulan fī arbaʿi r-rumumi
qāla n-najāshīyu idh lil'arḍi qad balaghū antum suyūmun wa ṭayru sh-shari lam yasumi
min qiṣṣati n-najmi ’ābū rājiʿīna ilá nakhwi l-'ahālī wazādū shiddata s-sakhami
idh qāla tilka l-gharānīqu l-ʿulá sajadū ẓannū lijahlihimu taʿẓīma amrihimi
lakinnahā qiṣṣatun akhyārunā ṭaʿanū fīhā kadhā ṭ-ṭaʿnu fī r-rāwīna min umami
wathānīan hājarū ayḍan waniswatuhum ḥayyun rijāluhumu fī ʿiddati l-jamami
khābū wa dhallū fayā bu'sá liman kafarū idh arsalū linnajāshī rawma raddihimi
waqāla law ji'tumu l-'ajbāla min dhahabin fadhāka lastu unbālī lā walam asumi
wahum li'iṭfā'i nūri l-khāliqi j-tamaʿū lammā fashā khabaru l-'islāmi fī l-'umami
jā'ū ilá ʿammih jīman liyakhdhulahu min yabghi bayḍa anūqin ʿāqilan yulami
bikhaṭṭi manṣūra shallat kaffuhu shalalan ṣaḥīfatan katabū waylan limujtarimi
idh ḥāza sabʿata aʿwāmin nubūwatahu kāna l-ḥiṣāru mina l-'aʿdā dhawī l-jurami
wakhabbara l-muṣṭafá min annahā ukilat liʿammihi yā lahu min ṣādiqin karami
waqāla yā ʿammu inna l-laha sallaṭa ar ḍatan ʿalayhā siwá mā kāna lilḥakami
ʿāmayni bal qīla jīmun kāna muddatuhu waqīla baynahumā nahja l-hudá s-taqimi
waʿāma duhmin thamānī ashhurin wa ayin yawman tawá ʿammuhu n-naṣṣāru dhā zamami
baʿda l-khurūji thamānī ashhurin wa akin yawman mina l-ḥaṣri kun fī l-ʿilmi dhā sadami
min qabli hijrati khayri l-khalqi shāfiʿinā jīma s-sinīna falā talḥaẓ likhulfihimi
wa'ahlu dhā l-fanni fī islāmihi kh-talafū warajjaḥū mawtahu fī l-kufri wānniqami
man athbata l-mawta ḥibrun ʿaylamu l-ʿulamā faḥlu l-fuḥūlati ʿabbāsun ʿalá s-salami
waʿan thalāthati ayyāmin khadījatu qad tawat wadhalika ʿāmu l-ḥuzni wālghumami
ʿalá ṣ-ṣaḥīḥi aqāmat ʿinda sayyidinā khamsan waʿishrīna ʿāman aḥsana l-qiyami
wasawdatun zūwijat khayra l-wará sharafan min baʿdihā wahya dhātu s-sinni wālharami
min ajli mawtayhimā l-'aʿdā'u qad ṭamiʿū fī l-muṣṭafá mukthirīna ḍ-ḍurra min aḍami
min baʿdimā ashhurin jīmin ya'ummu biʿā mi ʿashratin ṭā'ifan yadʿū ilá l-ḥakami
aqāma ʿindahumu shahran yurājiʿuhum walam yujībūhu bal mālū ilá sh-shajami
waṣalliyan yā ilāhī wājziyan abadan ʿannā muḥammadanā l-mukhtāra fī l-qidami
wakāna idh dhāka maʿ zaydi b-ni ḥārithatin yaqīhi min nafsihi aw shujja min qazami
waʿabda yālīlin masʿūdan ḥabīban atá kamustajīrin biʿamrinw min ʿinādihimi
lāqá mina s-sufahā mā lā afūhu bihi wāssāqa admaw wasāla d-dammu lilqadami
wābnā rabīʿata lilʿaddāsi qad dafaʿā hadīyatan ʿinaban yuhdīhi lilkarami
akabba taqbīla aṭrāfi r-rasūli wahal bahīmatun tastawī bilʿāqili sh-shahimi
wafī ṭarīqatihi hadhī daʿā biduʿā in kāna mushtahira t-tafrīji lilhimami
lawlā n-nabīyu rasūlu l-lahi lākhturimū bil'aḥshabayni walakin manna min karami
afāqa bilqarni ay qarni th-thaʿālibi aw qarnu l-manāzili mīqātun linajdihimi
wāljinnu marrū bihi mustaslimīna lahu fī nakhlatin ’ā'iban lilḥilli wālḥarami
wakāna lam yashʿuran biljinni aw nazalat wa'idh ṣarafnā fanāla l-ʿilma kālʿalami
wa'idh atá b-nu ʿadīyin kāna jāwarahu khayra l-jiwāri ʿalá ikrāmi muntaqimi
wafī zakin qad khalat fī shahri mawlidihi mina n-nubūwati ʿāma l-ḥubbi lilqudhami
asrá bihi l-lahu tashrīfan limaknatihi ḥattá ra'á mā ra'á min ’āyihi l-jusumi
wadhāka fī yaqaẓin isrā l-manāmi jalun wahakadhā dhakara sh-shaʿrāni lātaghimi
ʿalá l-burāqi sará fī l-muntahá lahumu jā'a l-khilāfu farājiʿ julla kutbihimi
bi’ādamin marra ʿīsá yūsufin wakhanū khin thumma hārūna mūsá wāl'abi r-raḥimi
wathāba mustanqiṣan lilkhamsi thumma ghadā mustaḥyīan inna dhāka l-badra dhū r-ratami
watilka khamsu farīḍātin yakūnu lahā thawābu khamsīna fī ikhlāṣi mukhtadimi
waʿāda lil'ahli dhū t-taṣdīqi fāza bihi waḍidduhu fī halākin ghayri munḥasimi
wajīma ʿashrata ʿāman fī quraysha thawá munādīan qawmahu wālqawmu fī l-ḥarami
lakinnahu lam yazal yaqfū mawāsimahum yarjū mina l-lahi ʿawnan ghayra muttaṣimi
fabāyaʿa l-karama l-'anṣāra fī l-ʿuqabā ti rabbi asbil ʿalayhim wābila l-karami
wāwun ladá l-ʿuqabati l-'ūlá wabaʿdu yabun wabaʿda dhā jā'ahu th-thintāni biljalami
ẓannū bi'anna hudānā sawfa yakhdhuluhum aw ṣādiqan qāla innī hadmukum hadamī
wahājara ṣ-ṣaḥbu arsālan muhājaratan min qabli dhāka mu'ākhātun maʿa l-'udami
sirran siwá ʿumara l-fārūqi aḥzamihim lam yabqa maʿhu siwá ṣ-ṣiddīqi wālqudumi
alā qurayshun bidāri n-nadwati j-tamaʿū khawfa r-rasūli wanajdīyun biḥizbihimi
wa'ajmaʿa l-kullu lil'iṭfā'i mā ʿalimū bi'anna dhalika nūru l-lahi fī l-qidami
wayamkurūna gh-tirāran dhāka da'buhumu wayamkuru l-lahu itmāman lidhullihimi
wa r-rūḥu qad adhina l-mukhtāra hijratahu ilá maqāmi wafā'i l-ʿahdi wa dh-dhimami
waqāla lā tastabit yā khīrata l-kuramā ʿalá firāshika wāl'aʿdā'u fī himami
jā'a r-rasūlu ʿatīqan fī taqannuʿihi naḥra ẓ-ẓahīrati fī hammin wamuʿtazami
qālū laqad jā'anā fī ghayri sāʿatihi wadhā la'amrun atá min rabbinā l-ḥakami
waqāla akhrij biman fī l-bayti qāla lahu waghayra ahlika mā fī l-bayti min arimi
waqāla qad jā'anā mā kuntu muntaẓiran min idhni hijratinā liddāri fāḥtazimi
qāla ṣ-ṭiḥāban wa'idh qāla n-nabīyu naʿam baká surūran kaman fī shiddati l-'alami
wāstaghrabat wataqūlu l-bintu ʿā'ishatun mā kuntu adrī bukā'an fī surūrihimi
waqad aʿadda abū bakrin lihijratihi rāḥilatayni jazāhu l-lahu dhū n-niʿami
iḥdāhumā qad sharāhā l-badru maʿdilatan tudʿá biʿaḍbā'a ḥaddith amrahā wasimi
waqad anāba ʿalīyan kay yarudda ilá dhawī l-'amānāti īyāhā bilā yatami
ʿalá l-firāshi yabītu l-ḥabru muttashiḥan biburdihi yaḥsibūna l-laytha fī l-'ajami
ṣārū waqad bāna ḥaqqan khulfu ẓannihimi mumāthilī l-kusaʿī fī l-ḥuzni wānnadami
wasalhumu wayla shamlin khā'ibīna idhā dharra t-turāba l-muqaffī fī ru'ūsihimi
yāsīnu yaqra'u yāsīnan fajā'a lahu wiqāyahun lam yanal man kāna fī l-'ujumi
qad akhrajū ḍāribīna l-badra ḥaydaratan wasāʿatan ḥabasūhu min ʿinādihimi
ʿāma th-thalāthati wālkhamsīna bāna biman fadá bihi nafsahu fī l-ghāri dhī l-ghasami
waqad mashá ḥāfīan wālbarru yaḥmiluhu jihātihi d-dāla yamshī khīfata l-'aḍami
shāmū burūqahumā ṣumman masāmiʿuhum walā yará sh-shamsa rumṣun wahya fī t-tahami
yabītu ʿindahumā ʿabdu l-'ilahi wayar ʿá ʿāmirun lahumā qul minḥata l-ghanami
ta'tī ṭ-ṭaʿāma lahum fī l-ghāri bintu abī bakrin waqad taʿibat fī amri zādihimi
dhāta n-niṭāqayni sammūhā lishaqqi niṭā qihā litarbiṭa yā ṭūbá lidhī l-khidami
waqarra jīma layālin fīhi muḥtaraman birā'atin ʿankabūtin thumma wurqi ḥamī
qāla th-thabīru lahu fāhbiṭ waqāla lahu ḥirā ilayya rasūla l-ʿurbi wa l-ʿajami
wābnu l-'urayqiṭi ʿabdu l-lahi dalla ʿalá khayri l-'imāmi imāman khīrata l-'umami
waʿāmirun sayyidī ṣ-ṣiddīqu ardafahu likay yuʿīnahumā fī n-nahji min khidami
wālmālu lilghāri ʿabdu l-lahi ḥāmiluhu asmā'u qul jaddahā gharrat mina l-'irami
waqīla khamsatu ’ālāfin wa'arbaʿatun aw sittatun ruwiyat min ʿindi baʿḍihimi
niʿma r-rafīqu laqad sawwá makāna mafīlihi waqad nāma taḥta ṣ-ṣakhrati l-ʿamami
waqad atá kuthbatan lilbadri min labanin wajālibun dhāka min rāʿin ʿalá ghanami
sal umma maʿbada dhāta sh-shāti ḥīna aḍā fati r-rasūla biʿāmi l-jadbi wāl'izami
aw sal surāqata mā lāqá bishayẓamihi idh kāna mustalḥiqan bilkhayri wa l-karami
hunāka qad ḥazina ṣ-ṣiddīqu dhā walahin min kawnihi biḥabībi l-lahi dhā sadami
bal sal buraydata wārrāʿī ʿalá ghanamin mādhā ra'á fī ḥ-tilābi l-badri min ghudhami
wa'ahlu makkata lawlā l-jinnu mā ʿalimū ayna n-taḥá dāfiʿu l-'awzāri wāssaqami
kasā zubayrun rasūla l-lahi ṣāḥibahu idh lāqayāhu birakbin ’āba min sha'ami
yaghdūna kulla ghadātin aw yaruddahumu ḥarru ẓ-ẓahīrati ahlu ṭ-ṭā'ibi l-ḥarami
taqallabū dhāta yawmin lilbuyūti waqad ra'á n-nabīya yahūdīyun ʿalá l-'uṭumi
nādāhumu qā'ilan qad lāḥa jaddukumu qāmū ilayhi sirāʿan fī silāḥihimi
lāqawhu fī nakhlatin idh dhāka qawluhumu alā d-khulā lā takhāfā sharra dhī l-waghami
iẓlālu sayyidinā ṣ-ṣiddīqi ʿarrafahum īyāhu qul innahu min afḍali l-lumami
wamin thamāniyati l-'ayyāmi jāba ʿalá tilka l-masāfati lam yatham walam yanami
ḥīna sh-tidādi ḍ-ḍaḥá fī ḥubbi mawlidihi jazmu n-nawāwī bihadhā ghayru muktatami
ladá banī ʿamrinw l-ḥāwīna kulla ʿulan fī dāri kulthūma najli hadmin l-karami
muḥaddithan bayta saʿdin ṣaḥbahu l-ʿulamā dāru l-khubaybi maḥaṭṭu l-lummati l-ʿamami
hunāka adrakahu laythu l-'usūdi ʿalī maʿa ḍ-ḍiʿāfi wabaʿda l-badri lam yaqumi
wa'inna aṣbuʿahu qad qīla qad damiyat waqāla mā anta illā aṣbuʿun bidami
aqāma ʿinda l-qubā dālan wa assasa mā qad kāna ussisa fī t-taqwá maʿa l-'udami
wa dhāka awwalu mā ṣallá n-nabīyu bihi jamāʿatan ʿalanan maʿ ṣaḥbihi l-karami
yawma l-ʿarūbati jalla l-badru tudrikuhu ṣalātuhā fa'atāhā ghayra muʿtatimi
ladá banī sālimi l-ʿālīna fī mi'atin yā fawzahum ʿinda rānūnā'a wādihimi
maḍá waman marra minhum qā'ilūna lahu alqi l-ʿaṣā talqa khayra l-'amni wāl'udami
walam yazal qā'ilan mustanzilīhi fahī ma'mūratun dhātu idhnin sawwimū tasumi
min ajli dhalika qad arkhá z-zimāma lahā ḥattá tanawwakha bāba l-masjidi l-ḥarami
wa l-badru mā ḥalla ʿanhā thumma qad wathabat sārat walam tan'a wāljaḥjāḥu lam yaqumi
wa qāṭiʿun abḥuran yā'an bihā sabaqa l-jamīʿa min naẓratin wālḥubbi wa r-ruḥumi
idhā waḍaʿtīhi sammīhi muḥammadan l-'amra k-tumī ayya kitmānin fataghtanimi
kadhā l-ghamāmu l-ladhī mā fīhi fīhi mina l-gharā'ibi l-ghurri kashfa s-siri lā tasumi
ṣadrun waqalbun fu'ādun lilḥabībi mina l-'ikhlāṣi wārraḥmati l-ʿuẓmá wamin rakhami
warīquhu shaʿruhu l-'aṣfá famin ʿasali l-jannati wānnabti ammā l-kaffu min karami
waqad hawat shurufātu l-bayti wānhadama l-'īwānu wālmā'u mithlu n-nāri fī z-zarami
ini t-tilāwatu qad baqqat waqad ẓahara l-wālī l-hirāwati wayla l-fursi wālsha'ami
fī yawmi l-ithnayni fī faṣli r-rabīʿi wadhā ka l-qawlu maʿmūlu ahli l-ma'mani l-ḥarami
waqīla baʿda khulūwi l-laylatayni qadi kh-tāra l-ḥumaydī th-thamānī wābnu ḥazmihimi
wakāna fī s-sanati l-'ūlá yusāqu ilá ḥalīmatin binti ʿabdi l-lahi dhī l-qadami
fī dāri rā'iʿatin qabran lahā dhakara l- qāmūsu fīhā biʿaynin ghayri munʿajimi
idh karrara l-ghaṭṭa marrātin yaqūlu lahu q- ra' bismi rabbika anta l-khātimu n-nuẓumi
waqīla fī rajabin fī dhalika l-ʿamalu l-’āna s-salāmu ʿalá l-mukhtāri dhī l-qadami
rafīquhu r-rūḥu fī s-tiftāḥi ahli s-samā l-bībāni wāstabsharū min qādimin qadimi
fī yawmi l-ithnayni qad kāna l-khurūju kamā kāna d-dukhūlu wālistinbā'u fīhi numī
mashá biʿaṣmati rabbī aw anāḥa ladá l-qubā ʿaḍūman bilā ḍayrin walā tahami
ilā thalāthata ayyāmin waqad amara l-hādī bihijratihi tārīkha amrihimi
fī masjidin qadri niṣfi l-qaddi qad duʿiya l-ghubayba taṣghīra ghabbin sā'ilī gh-tanimi
wakulluhā lirasūli l-lahi kammalahā l-raḥmānu lā tas'alan mā ḥāza min ḥikami
wa kāna ya'muruhu mūsá r-rujūʿa ilá l-raḥmāni mustathqilan ḥamla l-hudá l-karami
talaffatat khalfahā l-qaṣwā'u rājiʿatan wāhan wawāhan lahā lilmabraki l-qadimi
talaḥlaḥat arzamat qaṣwā'u wāḍiʿatan jirānahā innahā fī l-ʿaqli kāshshahimi
waqaddimi l-lāma aw akhkhirhu muhmila ḥā aw muʿjiman qāla dhā l-ḥalbīyu dhū l-karami
qāla l-maḥallu hunā in shā'a khāliqunā walilyatīmayni kānat mirbada l-hanami
wa'innahu nazala l-mukhtāru ʿinda abī ayyūba ḥāmila raḥli l-muṣṭafá l-qadimi
fī asfali d-dāri ḥalla l-badru qad ṭalabū nuzūlahu fawqu baʿda l-manʿi dhū salami
kharajna bīḍu banī n-najjāri min ṭarabin muhayyijātin fu'āda l-ḥibbi dhī l-faghami
yaqulna naḥnu jawārin ḍāribāti dufū fin laysa fī ḍarbihā tāllahi min ithami
lilahi jāriyatun qālat mughanniyatan fahal ʿalayya idhā alhū mina l-jurami
waqāla lā khayru khalqi l-lahi mubtasiman in shā'ahu l-lahu dhāka l-fawzu wālḥakami
daʿā l-ghulāmayni baʿda l-ḥaṭṭi malja'unā ṣallá ʿalayhi ilāhī munzilu r-ruḥumi
thumma sh-tará l-mirbada l-mawṣūlu maʿdilatan min māli ṣiddīqihi l-maʿrūfi bilkarami
wafīhi masjidahu yabnī wasaqqafahu mina l-jarīdi yusāwī qāmata n-nasami
muẓallalun ṣuffatan yadʿūnahu fabihi ya'wī ilayhi masākīnun mina l-'umami
ʿinda t-taʿashshī n-nabi l-hādī yufarriquhum ʿalá ṣ-ṣaḥābati ya'tī l-'ahla bil'umami
likathrati n-nāsi khayru l-khalqi shāfiʿunā min baʿdi khaybara fīhi kāna dhā wadhami
kamā baná ḥujratan fīhi liʿā'ishatin wamā lisawdata ayḍan ghayru muktatimi
aqāma da'ban ilá itmāmi masjidihi waḥujratayhi jazá l-'anṣāra dhū n-nasami
wayanqulu ṣ-ṣakhra bil'aṣḥābi qā'ila lā khayran siwá khayri l-ukhrá rabbi fājzihimi
kun nāṣiran rabbanā l-'anṣāra naṣraka lilmuhājirīna waman min baʿdu fī umami
wa'asʿadun thumma saʿdun yursilāni lahu khayra ṭ-ṭaʿāmi wasaʿdun laysa dhā sa'ami
yā ṭaybatan ṭāba fīhā l-ʿayshu ʿajwatuhā turābuhā fashifā'u l-judhmi wāshshabimi
ṭāba l-ʿayāmu waṭāba sh-sharqu min faraḥin ṭāba l-hawīmu ṭulūʿa l-badri fī l-ghumami
wākhá dhawī l-hijri wāl'anṣāri sayyidunā min baʿdihā ashhurin bilḥaqqi wālḥurami
tisʿīna kānū wakānat kullu ṭā'ifatin ʿalayhimu raḥmatu r-raḥmāni ʿadda hami
wamawlayā sayyidī ṣ-ṣiddīqu qad wuʿikā kahu waqad kāna fī baytin dhawī hazami
wāstawkhama ṭ-ṭaybata l-gharrā'a ummatuhu hawā'uhā lam yuwāfiq min mizājihimi
waqāla ḥabbib ilaynā rabbi ṭaybatanā kaḥubbi makkata ummi r-ruḥmi wārraḥimi
amā l-wabā min duʿā'i l-badri muntaqilun ʿani l-madīnati naḥwa l-juḥfati l-'adami
naḥā abā rāfiʿin zaydan bithā wariqan maʿa l-baʿīrayni irsālan ilá l-ḥashami
wa'umma aymana jā'ā sawda fāṭimatan usāmatan umma kulthūmin ʿiyan taqumi
amā ruqayyatu maʿ ʿuthmāna zaynabu ʿinda zawjihā b-ni rabīʿin ghayra mustalimi
wakāna bilbadri ma'sūran wa'arsalahā ilá l-madīnati baʿda l-manni wālkarami
wazaynabun baʿathat ḥaqqan qilādatahā fidan wamanna abūhā shiddata r-rakhami
amā l-ʿatīqu faʿabdu l-lahi jā'a lahu ʿiyālahu ummahu asmā'a birrasami
wa'umma rawmāna aʿnī umma ʿā'ishatin waʿā'ishan maʿa ʿabdi l-lahi dhī l-qiyami
walinnabī adhina l-bārī binaṣbi raḥan taduqqu hāmata dhī l-'inkāri wāshshaḥami
wa'awwalan ’āyatu l-ḥajji l-ladhī nazalat min baʿdi waʿdi difāʿin min ilahihimi
wabaʿdu ya'ayyuhā jā'at mukarraratan mina l-kitābi l-ʿazīzi l-muḥkami r-tasimi
thumma b-tadā billadhī min khawfihi ṭalabū iṭfā'ahu zā'idīna n-nāra biḍḍarami
yā rubba yawmin tawāṣaw lilikifāḥi bihi biljiddi law yanfukhūna l-yawma fī faḥami
liḥamzatin ʿaqada l-mukhtāru alwiyatan ʿubaydatin thumma saʿdin ḍayghami l-buhami
fī ra'si zāyin waqāla l-baʿḍu dhāka jará fī l-ʿāmi tābiʿi l-ūlá yā likhulfihimi
wikā maghāzīhi yahdī mubridan kabidan ʿalá khilāfin atānā min dhawī l-qadami
abwā buwāṭun ʿushayrun thumma ghazwatu safwānin wabadru qitālin maʿ sulaymihimi
waqaynuqāʿun sawīqun baʿdahu ghaṭafā nun thumma buḥrānu uḥdun waqʿatu l-ghumami
ḥamrā naḍīrun riqāʿun mawʿidun maʿa dū matin muraysīʿu wāl'aḥzābu lā tanami
qurayẓatun thumma laḥyānun ḥudaybiyatun waghābatun khaybarun wādī l-qurá s-talimi
waʿumratun lilqaḍā fatḥun ḥunaynu waṭā 'ifun tabūkun lirūmin fī quṣūrihimi
binafsihi qad ghazā hadhī bilā kadhibin fī t-tisʿi salla suyūfan judna lirrakhami
fatḥun muraysīʿu badrun khaybarun uḥudun qurayẓatun ṭā'ifun wālkhandaqu s-taqimi
ḥunaynu zīda naḍīrun thumma wādi quran waghābatun wālsarāyā fahya ʿaddu zami
mā zāla yaghzūhumu ḥattá humu dakhalū fī d-dīni fawjan fafawjan muddata l-'umami
ḥajja r-rasūlu thalāthan qabla hijratihi baʿdu ḥ-suban ḥajjata l-'islāmi tantaẓimi
wakāna khayru l-wará sittīna baʿda thalā thin muʿtiqan muhdīan fīhā mina l-karami
wa'arbaʿun ʿumaru l-hādī wa qīla thalā thun lā tará abadan muḥṣi kh-tilāfihimi
wakulluhā kāna fī dhī qiʿdatin waqaʿat amit ʿubaydaka fī l-'īmāni wa s-salami
sallim ʿalá sayyidin khuṣṣat shafāʿatuhu dhawī l-kabā'iri kay yanjū mina n-niqami
awlāduhu bittifāqin sittatun waʿalá l-'aṣaḥḥi zāyun faqaddim qāsiman bihimi
wakunyatu l-muṣṭafá bilqāsimi sh-taharat qad ʿāsha ʿāmayni barqa l-khulfi lā tashimi
baʿda r-risālati ʿabdu l-lahi jī'a bihi mulaqqaban ṭāhiran wāṭṭayyiba sh-shiyami
waqīla ghayrāni ibrāhīmu aṣgharuhum qabla l-bulūghi atāhum zā'iru l-ḥimami
wakulluhum ghayra ibrāhīma qad wulidū fī makkata l-baldati l-maḥrūsati l-ḥarami
fī ṭaybatin jī'a ibrāhīmu ʿāma thamā nin wafqa dhī ḥijjatin min hijrati l-karami
fī sinnihi kh-talafū wālkhulfu ʿādatuhum walāzimanna ʿalá mā ṣaḥḥa tastaqimi
muṭayyabun ṭayyibun fī l-baṭni qad wulidā muṭahharun ṭāhirun ṣinwāni fī r-raḥimi
kadhāka ʿabdu manāfin qabla biʿthatihi yughzá ilá khayri khalqi l-lahi kullihimi
wazaynabun ummu kulthūmin wafāṭimatun ruqayyatun farayāḥīnu r-riḍá l-ʿalami
wafāṭimun ummu kalthūmin fakhayru banā tihi batūlun lahā zaydun mina s-sadami
adrakna biʿthatahu aslamna kunna mina l-muhājirāti ilá l-marḥūmati l-ḥarami
yā rabbi fārḍa ʿani l-'awlādi kullihimi waṣalliyanna ʿalá hādī l-wará l-qudumi
wazaynabun hiya kubrāhunna wākhtalafū fīhā wafī qāsimin bilḥaqqi fāratasimi
mīlāduhā ʿāma lāmin ḥalla mahlakuhā ʿāma thamānin mina l-gharrā'i lilḥakami
waḍammahā b-nu rabīʿin muslimayni ʿalá l-tartībi wa l-ḥablu ḥaqqan ghayru mukhtadhimi
min baʿdi ʿāmayni qad ruddat ilayhi waqīla baʿda sittati aʿwāmin mina l-'umami
aw baʿda ʿiddatihā jā'at lahu biʿalī wabil'umāmati zawji l-ḥaydari r-ruzami
min baʿdi fāṭimata l-miṣbāḥi khālatihā ʿalayhimā aḥsanu r-riḍwāni wārruḥumi
wamin waṣīyatihi ḥaqqan tazawwajahā mughīratun wa'atat yaḥyá lahu n-taẓimi
amā ʿalī faradīfun wāl'umāmatu ḥimlu l-muṣṭafá fī ṣalāti ṣ-ṣubḥi min rakhami
ruqayyatun wulidat lilhādi ʿāma jalin wafī l-madīnati mātat mītata l-karami
kubrá ladá b-ni hishāmin min banāti rasū linā ruqayyatu fāftaḥ qāfahā taqumi
wafātuhā baʿda ʿāmin thumma ʿashrati ashhurin wa ʿishrīna yawman maqdama l-wasimi
wakāna ʿuthmānu ʿan badrin takhallafa minhā qā'iman rāḥiman fī l-qabri dhā himami
ʿutaybatun ʿutbatun kānā qadi ḥ-tawayā ruqīyatan umma kulthūmin mina n-nujumi
wafāraqā dhaynika n-najmayni idh nazalat tabbat yadā zā'iday tabbin maʿa l-wakhami
qamīṣa khayri l-wará qad shaqqahu wasaṭan ʿutaybatun fajazāhu l-lahu bilfaghimi
ina b-na ʿaffāna dhā n-nūrayni luqqiba idh ḥāza nūray nabīyi l-lahi dhī l-ḥikami
tazwīja l-ūlá ladá ummi l-qurá dhakarū wahājarā hijratay ḥabshin dhaway udami
hunāka jā'at salīlan baʿdahā faqaḍá ʿāma th-natayni b-na sittin hijrata l-khadhimi
wakāna yukaná bihi wāddīku yanquru min ʿaynayhi qad māta ʿabdu l-lahi bilwarami
wa'ukhtuhā ḥāzahā ʿāma th-thalāthati lam talid wafī t-tisʿi ḥallat dākhila r-rajami
umu l-ʿaṭīyati maʿ asmā'a binti ʿumaysin wāṣṣafīyatu hunna l-ghāsilātu simi
ṣallá ʿalayhā abūhā ṣalli rabbi ʿalá khayri l-barīyati min ʿurbin wamin ʿajami
lilahi lilahi tazwījun qada kh-barahu jibrīlu min rabbihi lilḥibbi dhī l-karami
fī akbara l-khulfu min hātayni fāṭimatun ṣughrá waqad wulidat lilbadri ʿāma ami
wabinta tisʿin waʿishrīna l-mamātu lahā min baʿdimā ghāba wāwan khīratu l-ʿiyami
ʿāma l-ḥibā bibaqīʿin wahya qad dufinat ṣallá ʿalayhā ʿalīyun madkhalu l-ḥikami
ina l-batūla biwaḥyin kāna zawwajahā khayru l-wará thumma aʿdā fārisa l-buhami
min baʿdimā radda ṣiddīqan kadhā ʿumarun wāllaythu mā ḥāza illā d-dirʿa min niʿami
waqad ḥawat sanatan jayban wakhamsata ashhurin waniṣfan ʿafīfan afḍala l-jidhami
wadhāka fī sannatin yā ṣāḥi thānīyatin min hijrati l-badri dhī l-’āyāti wānniʿami
walam yakni lirasūli l-lahi min ʿaqibin min ghayrihā falahā fakhrun bilā shamami
muḥassinan waḥusaynan qad atat ḥasanan wazaynaban umma kulthūmin mina n-nujumi
ruqayyatun zādahā b-nu s-saʿdi fī ṣigharin mithla l-muḥassini mātat yā la'ummihimi
wazaynaban ḥāza ʿabdu l-lahi thumma lahu atat ʿalīyan waʿabbāsan biʿawnihimi
muḥammadan umma kulthūmin sulālatuhā bikathratin rājiʿi l-'isʿāfa taghtanimi
wahwa ʿalá sīrati l-mukhtāri thumma mazā yā ahli bayti l-hudá bushrá liḥibbihimi
wa'ukhtu zaynaba lilfārūqi qad waladat zaydan ruqayyata ʿawnun ḍammahā walami
muḥammadun baʿda ʿawnin qad tazawwajahā tuwufiyat ʿinda ʿabdi l-lahi dhī r-raḥimi
wamā atat lahumu naslan yabīnu wafī mawāhibin qad atat bintan lithānihimi
mamātuhā mawtu zaydin qul qadi q-taranā ṣallá ʿalá dhayni ʿabdu l-lahi dhū l-karami
nafyu t-tawāruthi wāttaqdīmu qad atayā ḥukmayni ʿi l-ʿilma taqṭif thamrata l-ḥikami
yā rabbi ṣalli ʿalá l-hādī wa shīʿatihi waʿudda jamʿiya faḍlan fī jumūʿihimi
azwājuhu ummahātu l-mu'minīna ḥibā fī ghayri dhāka kh-tilāfun fī rusūmihimi
khadījatun fahī l-'ūlá l-latī sabaqat sumātuhā qablu fāqat kulla muftakhimi
ṣārat ilá raḥmati r-raḥmāni binta ṣahin min qabli hijratihi jīman falā tahimi
mina n-nubūwati ʿāma l-ʿashri fī ramaḍā na jāwarat bilḥajūni l-laḥda wā haramī
walam yuṣalli ʿalayhā l-badru shāfiʿunā sallim ʿalayhi ilahī ghayra munkhadhimi
wabaʿdahā sawdatu l-muthlá tazawwajahā min baʿdi sakrāna ʿāma l-ʿashri lilḥazimi
wahājarā hijratan lilḥabshi thāniyatan sakkinhumā jannata l-firdawsi dhā n-niʿami
fī sawdatin qad rawaw khulfan waʿā'ishatin man hiya thāniyatun ʿi l-qawla tastanimi
wa'ashharu l-qawli an mātat khilāfata fā rūqin bi’ākhirihā daʿ ghayra dhā taqumi
idh hamma khayru l-barāyā tarkahā jaʿalat manābahā limuṣaffātin ʿani t-tuhami
wa binta sittin ḥawá l-mukhtāru ʿā'ishatan min qabli hijratihi jīman falā taghimi
bimakkatin ʿāma ʿashrin fī sh-shawāli badā tārīkhu mawlidihā fī d-dāli min umami
fī ṭaybatin ʿāma iḥdá kāna mubtanīan bihā lahā tisʿatu l-'aʿwāmi faltasumi
aw ʿāma bā'in ʿalá l-qawli ḍ-ḍaʿīfi lahā ʿashru s-sinīna waniṣfun dūna muttahami
waghāba ʿanhā lahā ḥayyun biʿāmi ḥanin tuwuffiyat ʿumruhā idh dhāka fī wakami
abū hurayrata qad ṣallá bihā dufinat ʿinda l-baqīʿi maḥalli l-'amni wāssalami
wamā tazawwaja bikran ghayrahā walidhā kānat aḥabba bilā shakkin walā tuhami
faqīhatun ʿadda wardin qad rawat khabaran min baʿdi alfay ḥadīthin wahya lam taṣimi
waḥāza baʿda khunaysin ḥafṣatan watawat taḥtāzu sittīna fī hammin waqīla ami
ʿalá khilāfati mawlānā muʿāwiyatin waqīla ʿuthmānu dhū n-nūrayni wālkarami
marwānu ṣallá ʿalayhā ḥāmilan ka'abī hurayratin naʿshahā yā ṭaybata l-khadami
wahya l-latī amara l-’āyātu rajʿatahā wadhāka fakhrun wafī t-taḥrīmi naqʿu ẓamī
tazwījuhā kāna fī shaʿbāna ṣāḥi ʿalá ra'si th-thalāthīna shahran lilhudá l-khadhimi
wakāna mawliduhā qabla n-nubūwati min khamsi s-sinīna rawat sittīna min ḥikami
umu l-masākīni hādīnā tazawwajahā baʿda b-ni jaḥshin ʿalá mā ṣaḥḥa min kalimi
muhājirun hijratay ḥabshin wafī uḥudin shahādatun nālahā maḥmūdata sh-shiyami
fī ʿāmi jīmin thawat shahrayni qīla thalā thatun thamāniyatun min qawli baʿḍihimi
tuwuffiyat wahya min ahli l-baqīʿi ajal binta th-thalāthīna ʿāma d-dāli fāftahimi
waqad thawat fī ḥayāti l-badri mithla khadījatin ʿalá l-barri taslīmun mina l-ḥakami
rayḥānatun ḥaythu ʿuddat zawjatan ʿadadan famithlu taynika lā tartab mina sh-shabimi
fī dhalika l-ʿāmi hindun qad tazawwajahā waḥāzahā qablu ʿabdu l-lahi lā tanami
wahājarā awwalan lilḥabshi inna lahā sabqa ẓ-ẓaʿā'ini naḥwa ṭ-ṭā'ibi l-ḥarami
mina n-nabīyi ʿadda kasḥin qad rawat khabaran waqalla mithlun lahā fī l-ḥusni wālqiyami
fī bayti zaynaba qad kāna l-binā'u bihā mātat wakāna lahā ʿīdun biʿāmi ṭamī
wafī wilāyati yāqawmī yazīda tawat asbil ʿalayhā ilāhī wābila r-rakhami
abū hurayrata qad ṣallá janāzatahā waramsuhā fī baqīʿin ghayru muktatimi
wabarratun bintu jaḥshin zaynaban duʿiyat ladá n-nabīyi imāmi l-'askhiyā l-huḍumi
min baʿdi mā qad qaḍá zaydun bihā waṭaran ḥ-tāzahā sūrata l-'aḥzābi fāltazimi
hilāla dhī qaʿdatin fī ʿāmi arbaʿatin ʿalá ṣ-ṣaḥīḥi lahā bajlun mina l-'umami
wafī l-madīnati dāri l-ḥaqqi qad halakat biʿāmi ʿishrīna inna l-ʿumra fī jiyami
ṣallá ʿalá naʿshihā l-fārūqu awwalu man baʿda n-nabīyi qaḍat fī l-madfani l-ḥarami
rawat aḥādītha yā'an thumma inna lahā fakhran bitazwīji rabbī l-ghāfiri l-'ithami
ʿāma l-muraysīʿi qad ḥīzat juwayriyatun ay ʿāma khamsin ladá dhī l-jūdi wālkarami
kāna s-muhā barratan ayḍan faḥawwalahā khayru l-barīyati ṭurrā kāshifu ẓ-ẓulami
fī sahmi thābita ḥallat wānnabīyu sharā hā minhu qīla abūhā l-khulfu lam yarimi
taḥta b-ni ṣafwāna kānat qabla shāfiʿinā tuwuffiyat ʿāma naw wālʿumru fī yakami
marwānu ṣallá ʿalayhā ṣalli rabbi ʿalá hādī l-barīyati ṭurran ʿīmati l-ʿiyami
zāyan rawat min ḥadīthin ḥāza ʿitratuhā mannan laqad ṣāharū ʿāfī junātihimi
minhunna bintu abī sufyāna man kharajat lilḥabshi taḥta ʿubaydi l-lahi dhī l-waghami
waqad tanaṣṣara murtaddan wamāta bihi fa'aʿṭi ʿabdaka rabbī khayra mukhtatami
wakhāṭiban mursilun ʿamran li'aṣḥamatin wafī l-walīyi kh-tilāfun jā mina l-'umami
fakhālidun fī aṣaḥḥi l-qawli qīla faʿuthmānu bnu ʿaffāna dhū n-nūrayni wārrakhami
wālmahru tā'u danānīrin tusāqu lahā mina n-najāshīyi ḥibbi sh-shāfiʿi n-nasami
fī ʿāmi sabʿin wakāna l-mawtu ḥalla bihā fī ṭaybatin ʿāma maddin qīla ʿāma bami
bintu bni akhṭaba hādīnā tazawwajahā ṣadāquhā ʿitquhā yā fawza mustalimi
qadi ṣ-ṭafāhā rasūlu l-lahi sayyidunā min sabyi khaybara fī sabʿin walam yaḍimi
wahya idhan mālahā zayun waʿashra aḥā dīthin rawat rabbanā sallim ʿalá l-ḥakami
min qablu taḥta salāmin thummata b-ni abī l-ḥuqayqi lakinnahā lam ta'ti bizzarami
mātat lahā ḍiʿfu lāmin fī l-baqīʿi rasat wadhāka fī ramaḍāna kāna ʿāam yami
maymūnatan nakaḥa l-mukhtāru fī sarafin kāna l-binā'u kadhāka l-mawtu fī iyami
ṣallá ʿalayhā b-nu ʿabbāsin waqad duʿiyat min qablu barrata mā ʿāshat siwá yalami
min qablu taḥta b-ni ʿamrinw thumma fāraqahā wabaʿda dhalika yaḥwīhā abū ruhumi
waqad rawat ʿadda lawmin rabbi ṣalli ʿalá man nūruhu fātiḥu l-'aghlāqi min ʿadami
ina l-ladhī qālahu l-jumhūru unkiḥa ʿumrata l-qaḍā'i ladá sabʿin mina l-'umami
min baʿdi khaybara fī dhī qaʿdatin waḥalā lan qīla n-kiḥahā kun sā'ila l-fahimi
yāllahu yā rabbi rabbī ṣalliyanna ʿalá nūri l-barīyati ṭurran sirri sirrihimi
akhīru man nakaḥa l-mukhtāru ’ākhiru man mātat mina ṭ-ṭayyibāti ṭ-ṭuhhari l-ghimami
maymūnatun zaynabun hindun wa ʿā'ishatun ḥafṣun ṣafīyatu bintu ṣ-ṣakhri dhī l-karami
wa sawdatun barratun aʿnī juwayriyatun tisʿun bawāqin warā'a l-muṣṭafá l-ʿalami
khadījatun ʿā'ishun ramlun waḥafṣatu hindun sawdatun liqurayshin maʿdini l-karami
wānsub ilá l-ʿarabi l-ʿarbā juwayriyatan maymūnatan zaynabayni ṭ-ṭuhhara sh-shiyami
ṣafīyatun kāsmihā bintu b-ni akhṭaba min asbāṭi hārūna taslīmī ʿalá l-hashimi
wamahru ghayri ṣafīyin ramlatin ʿadadan mina d-darāhimi sirrun ghayru muktatimi
khadījatun khayru hadhī thumma ʿā'ishatun wafīhimā l-khulfu jārin ʿinda muḥtakimi
amā sarārīhi dālun hunna māriyatun zalīkhatun bintu shamghūnin mina n-nasami
min binti jaḥshin lihādī l-khalqi jāriyatun tudʿá nafīsata mithla l-ismi fī l-karami
wālfāṭimātu l-lawātī qad waladna bihi ummu dh-dhabīḥi wa ʿamrinwin jaddihi l-karami
wa'ummuhā ummu ḥubbá thumma ummu quṣayyin binti saʿdin bikhulfin jā'a muntaẓami
wāḥidatun min qurayshin wāthnatāni famin qaysin wamin yamanin thintāni fārtasimi
ina l-ʿawātika tisʿun ʿadduhunna kamā fī l-jawharīyi wafī l-qāmūsi lā tahimi
waʿadduhunna kamā libni l-'athīri yabun fihrīyatāni thalāthun min sulaymihimi
lūlá faqul ʿammatu l-wusṭá wathāniyatun qul innahā ʿammatu l-'ukhrá bilā wahami
ʿadwīyatāni waman tuʿzá ilá asadin quḍāʿatin wahudhaylin thumma azdihimi
kadhā kināniyatin wānẓim bihinna waqul lakin ʿalá ghayri tartībin mina l-kalimi
bintu hilālin uhaybun kāna wālidahu ummu umaymata ummu taymin l-karami
waghālibin yakhludin saʿdin hilāla wamur ratin wālawqaṣu manẓūmun bisilkihimi
waʿāmirin thumma ʿadwānin kadhā azadun rashdānu dūdānu thumma l-ʿaddu lā tanami
banū sulaymin idhā mā fākharū nasaban tafākharū birasūli l-lahi dhī l-qadami
wafī l-ḥadīthi anā b-nun lilʿawātiki min sulaymin sh-shurafā yā ḥusna fakhrihimi
lahum mafākhiru shattá kāna ʿadduhumu fī l-fatḥi alfan fayā bushrá liwā'ihimi
qad kāna aḥmara fī t-taqdīmi fuzta ʿalá jamīʿi alwiyatin linnāsi kullihimi
waḥārithun wazubayrun ḥamzatun wa'abū lahbin abū ṭ-ṭālibi l-'aʿmāmu kālquthami
muqawwimun maʿa ʿabbāsin ḍirāru waʿabdu l-kaʿbati l-ḥajlu wālghaydāqu dhū l-karami
waḥadhfu ḥajlin waghaydāqin yuqālu kamā qad jā'a fī quthamin isqāṭu baʿḍihimi
waḥamzatun thumma ʿabbāsun qadi s-talamā waghayru dhaynika fī l-'islāmi lam yaqumi
arwá umaymatu bayḍā'un waʿātikatun ṣafīyatun barratun ʿammātu badri timi
wakulluhunna shaqīqātun liwālidihi illā ṣ-ṣafīyata wusṭá tālika n-nuẓumi
islāmu l-ūlá bihi khulfun kaʿātikatin ammā ṣ-ṣafīyatu ḥaqqan min dhawī s-salami
umu ḍirārin waʿabbāsin nutaylatu ṣaghghiran wakabbir idhā mā shi'ta lam tulami
muqawwimun ḥamzatun fāʿdud ṣafīyata min hālata binti wuhaybin jidda tuḥtarami
lubná abū lahabin minhā ṣafīyatu ḥā rithun wa'arwá faminhā dūna muttahami
amā mumannaʿatun qad qīla wālidatu l-ghaydāqi ḥajlin ʿalá mā ʿinda baʿḍihimi
wābnu qutaybata dhā t-tafṣīla jā'a bihi kitābahu rājiʿan taẓfar bidhī l-ḥikami
wafīhi baʿḍu kh-tilāfin min mawāhibinā lakinna raḥmata rabbī fī kh-tilāfihimi
akhwāluhu aswadun ʿabdu l-yaghūthi furayʿatun wafākhitatu z-zurqāni jā bihimi
khuddāmuhu anasu l-mashhūru thumma rabīʿatun wa'aymanu ʿabdu l-lahi dhū l-ḥurami
yalī l-wisādata wānnaʿlayni thumma ṭahū ran wāssiwāka bilālun munfiqu l-ḥarami
amā abū r-rāfiʿi l-qibṭī ʿalá thiqalin fī mashrubin adhina n-nūbīyu lilʿalami
aʿnī bihi ʿumara l-fārūqa ḥīna atá lilbābi musta'dhinan wānnāsu fī himami
waʿuqbatun huwa wālin amra baghlatihi quli l-muʿayqību ḥaqqan qayyimu l-khatami
ḥudhayfatu bnu l-yamāni l-yā'u munḥadhifun wakhaffifi l-mīma ḥāwī sirri dhī l-ḥikami
wa'aslaʿun huwa wālin amra rāḥilati l-mukhtāri khayri l-barāyā afḍali l-'umami
āyu t-tayammumi qālū fīhi qad nazalat waqīla ʿā'ishatun fī ashhari l-kalimi
wajundubun waḥunaynun wānnuʿaymu muhā jirun iyādun hilālun qul bisaʿdihimi
dhū mikhmarin minhumu asmā'u hindu akhū asmā waqad lāzamā min khidmati l-ḥakami
amā n-nisā'u fasalmá khawlatun barakun maymūnatun ummu ʿayyāshin mina l-ḥashami
razīnatun khaḍratun bilkhā'i muʿjamatan abū kuraybin rawá dhā l-qawla dhā ḥikami
minhunna bintu razīnin thumma māriyatun ṣafīyatun dhalika l-'aḥrāru min khadami
usāmatun fālmawālī thumma wāliduhu akhūhu aymanu thawbānun wālawsa simi
wamidʿamun thumma kaysānun wa'anjashatun shunqrānu thumma rabāḥun maʿ yasārihimi
wa'aslamun wāqidun abūhu ʿudda kadhā salmānu zaydun wamābūrun birā'a numī
faḍālatun rāfiʿun wāṣṣinwu kinkiratun bikasri kāfayhi shamghūnun bimunʿajimi
abū muwayhibatin saʿdun ḍumayratu sandarun wa ansatu maʿdūdun bijamʿihimi
rifāʿatun wahishāmun aḥmarun wakadhā ruwayfiʿun yā akhī taṣghīrahu adimi
abū lubābata hammāmun kadhāka abū hindin abū hāshimin min ʿindi baʿḍihimi
min ṭā'ifin khārijun lilbadri ʿaddu yajī minhum abū bakratin yā ḥusna ʿitqihimi
muḥammadun aflaḥun ʿudda ṭ-ṭabūkha lahu abā ʿubaydin ʿubaydun yā lanaẓmihimi
umaymatun barakun sīrīnu qaysaru ummu rāfiʿin hadhihi n-niswānu milḥashami
ruḍwá kasakrá walakin ʿaddahā biṣaḥā bīyātihi jaghfaru l-mustaghfirī r-rumumi
rayḥānu māriyatun salmá wabaʿḍuhumu l-'imā'u ayyun mawālī l-badri ʿaddu jami
muḥammadun wazubayrun ʿāṣimun waʿalī l-miqdādu ḍurrābun l-'aʿnāqa lilquthami
kadhā b-nu sufyāna qaysun qā'imun jaladun maqāma dhī shurṭatin fāḥfaẓ walā taghimi
ḥurrāsuhu b-nu muʿādhin bibni maslamatin wa khālidin wa abī bakrin ṣafīyihimi
mughīratun wābnu abbī marthadin wazubayrun maʿ bilālin biʿabbādin kadhāka ḥumī
kadhāka dhakwānu saʿdun innahum tarakū ḥirāsahu idh atāhu l-lahu min ʿiṣami
waʿāṣimun wakadhāka b-nu r-rawāḥati fī l-'asfāri yaḥdū jazāhu l-lahu dhū l-karami
yaḥdū r-rijāla barā'un thumma anjashatun ḥādī l-qawārīri niswāni n-nabī l-karami
wathābitun fakhaṭību l-muṣṭafá wa khaṭību l-ghurri ʿaybatihi anṣārihi l-ḥashami
muftīhi salmānu ʿabdu l-lahi thumma abū l-ddardā'i zaydun muʿādhun wābnu ʿawfihimi
salmāna ʿabdu l-lahi thumma abū l-d dardā'i zaydun muʿādhun wābnu ʿawfihimi
ḥudhayfatun wakadhā ʿammārun l-khulafā wālashʿarīyu ubayyan ʿudda talta'imi
mu'adhdhinūhu bilālun wāzziyādu wasaʿdun thumma awsun waʿabdu l-lahi wahwa ʿamī
innā'ibūna lahu waqta l-khurūji ilá ghazwin waḥajjin ḥumātu l-'ahli wālḥarami
ʿuwayfu ʿuthmānu ʿabdu l-lahi thumma abū lubābatin wa bashīrun maʿ abī ruhumi
numaylatun sā'ibun zaydun sibāʿu abū dujānatin thumma ʿabdu l-lahi dhū l-qadami
saʿdun muḥammadu ʿabdu l-lahi thumma abū dharrin ʿalayhim riḍá r-raḥmāni wārruḥumi
wāl'ashʿarī b-nu asīdin khālidun wa'abū sufyāna thumma ziyādun maʿ muʿādhihimi
kadhā yazīdun wabādhānun humu l-'umarā wallá ʿalá yamanin ṣihran huwa b-nu ʿami
amā ʿumānu faʿamrunwa kāna wāliyahā iqāmatu l-ḥajji fī tisʿin lidhī l-karami
aʿnī l-ʿatīqa rafīqa gh-ghāri munfiqa mā lihi ʿalá l-barri dūna l-manni wāssa'ami
ʿishrūna qalladahā l-hādī wa'arsalahā maʿa l-ʿatīqi wahā'an sāqa min naʿami
wabaʿda dhāka ʿalīyun kāna yatbaʿuhu barā'atan qāri'an binnāsi dhā ḥikami
radda l-ʿatīqa ʿalīyun ḥīna yalḥaquhu ʿalá n-nabī qā'iman idh jā'a dhā sajami
faqāla hal ḥādithun shay'un faqāla lahu bal kāna khayrun wadhā amrun mina l-ḥakami
ina b-na ḥanbala yarwī dhā bimusnadihi n-ẓurhu fī awwali l-'ajzā'i taghtanimi
suʿūdu n-nuqabā wābnu r-rawāḥati mundhirun ʿubādatu ʿabdu l-lhi lā tahimi
warāfiʿun wābnu tayhānin barā'u wa'asʿadun usaydun bitaṣghīrin bilā wahami
kullu nabīyin lahu zāyun mina n-nujabā waḍiʿfu dhalika lilhādī ilá l-'umami
sibṭāhu thumma ʿalīyun jaʿfarun ʿumarun waḥamzatun maʿa ṣiddīqin bilālihimi
ḥudhayfatun jundubun salmānu thummata miqdādun waʿammāru ʿabdu l-lahi dhū l-qadami
waṭalḥatun wa zubayrun saʿdun l-khulafā waḥamzatun wābnu ʿawfin sābighu n-niʿami
wajaʿfarun wābnu maẓʿūnin kadhāka abū ʿubaydatin faḥawārīyūna lilghudhami
amā muʿādhun kadhāka l-'ashʿarī wa ʿalī quḍātuhu l-ʿadlu fī ifḥāmi mukhtaṣimi
zubayrun l-khulafā saʿdun saʿīdu abū ʿubaydatin ṭalḥatun thumma b-nu ʿawfihimi
qul innahum ʿashratun ḥaqqa l-jinānu lahum tawassulī bihimu fī kulli muqtaḥami
wasūqu makka saʿīdun kāna wāliyahā kamā walī ʿumarun biṭṭā'ibi l-ḥarami
amā b-nu ʿawfin muʿayqībun quli l-'umanā abū usaydin bilālun mu'dhinu l-ḥalimi
wābnu r-rawāḥati ḥassānun kadhalika kaʿbun dāfiʿūna bishiʿrin ʿan nabīyihimi
wawafdu hamdāna idh jā'ūhu murtajizun min ʿindihi mālikun fī aḥsani n-naghami
kuttābuhu l-khulafā saʿdun zubayrun wa ṭalḥatun ubayyun abū sufyāna dhū l-ʿiẓami
zaydun yazīdu b-nu qaysin maʿ muʿāwiyatin ḥuwayṭibun washuraḥbīlun ʿalā'u numī
ʿamrun waḥanẓalatun wālkhālidāni ḥudhayfatun kadhāka muʿayqībun mina l-ḥashami
minhum muḥammadu ʿabdu l-lahi thummata ʿabdu l-lahi fārḍa ilāhī ʿan jamīʿihimi
minhum abānun ḥuṣaynun ʿāmirun wamughīratu b-nu saʿdin juhaymun fī ṭarīqihimi
min jāmiʿīna kitāba l-lahi fawzahumu ḥifẓan ʿalá ʿahdi khayri l-khalqi kullihimi
zaydun muʿādhun ubbīyun wāttamīmu abū ayyūba ʿuthmānu dhū n-nūrayni wālḥushumi
ʿubādatun wābnu masʿūdin kadhāka abū zaydin ʿalīyun abū d-dardā mina l-'umami
wasālimun ʿadduhu jā'a ṣ-ṣaḥīḥu bihi min ḥāfiẓīhi zamāna l-muṣṭafá l-milami
wahākumu rusulu l-hādī liman malakū ṣallá ʿalayhi ilāhī bāri'u n-nasami
waʿamran risalahu lilbarri aṣḥamatin wānqāda khayra n-qiyādin ghayra muttaghimi
amā l-ladhī qad tawallá baʿda aṣḥamatin fakāfirun ghayru maʿrūfi s-sumá l-ʿalami
wadiḥyatun lihiraqlin thumma arsala ʿabda l-lahi lilqitli kisrá wahwa lam yaqumi
idh jā'ahu mazzaqa l-ḥāmī famazzaqahu l-'ilāhu ḥāza ṣ-ṭilāman ayya muṣṭalami
hiraqlu qad jaʿala l-maktūba fī dhahabin waqawmuhu lam yazālū fī wirāthihimi
idh akhabrū dhalika t-taʿẓīma sayyidanā daʿā mujāban lahu tathbīta amrihimi
walilmuqawqisi aghrá ḥāṭiban ʿajilan ahdāhu jamman walakin ghayru dhī salami
mābū wabirrā'i aw hābū waqīla huwa b-nu ʿammi māriyata l-maḥbūbi dhū l-ḥamami
jīma l-jawārī ḥimāran baghlatan farasan warabʿatan ʿasalan mushṭan falā taṣimi
qārūrata d-duhni miswākan wa mukḥulatan kadhā miqaṣṣun ṭabībun ʿārifu s-saqami
ʿishrūna thawban waqāla l-baʿḍu kuffina fī baʿḍi th-thiyābi imāmu r-rusli kullihimi
waqul ilá l-ḥārithi l-ghassāni qad baʿatha l-shshujāʿa mustankifan ʿan daʿwati l-karami
waqīla baʿthu b-ni wahbin libni l-ayhami qīla baʿthuhu lahumā bal marratayni numī
naḥā salīṭu b-ni ʿamrin wa hawdhatan wathumā matan thumāmatu barrun laysa bilkhaṣimi
wadhū l-kalāʿi wa dhū ʿamrinw atá lahumā mustaslimayni jarīrun aḥsana l-kalimi
ʿamrun naḥā jayfaran ʿabdan wamā abayā amma l-ʿalā malika l-baḥrayni lam yaghimi
amā musaylimatu l-kadhdhābi andharahu ʿamrun wayadʿū sh-tirāka l-badri fī l-'imami
wafarwatun maʿa masʿūdi bni saʿda hadá lilbadri shahban ḥimāran wa l-jawāda simi
kadhā qabā'un wa athwābun hadīyatuhu maqbūlatun fī s-tilāmin khayri mustalami
aʿṭá n-nabīyu b-na saʿdin idh atāhu yaban awqīyatan farwatun lilqatli lam yakhimi
muhājirun ḥārithan ya'tī waqāla lahu innī sa'anẓuru fī amrī bidhī l-ḥikami
naḥā muʿādhun abū mūsá ilá yamanin fa'aslama l-jullu dūna l-kaddi wānniqami
wabaʿda dhāka ilayhim mursilun asadan laythan hizabran ʿalīyan muhlika ṣ-ṣimami
kāna n-nuʿaymānu ʿabdu l-lahi yuḍḥikuhu wafī suwaybiṭa ḍiḥkun ghayru mughtalimi
lahu mina l-khayli sakbun sabḥatun ẓaribun sijlun waṭirfun lizāzun dhū l-ʿiqāli numī
awwalu mā qad ghazá l-mukhtāru min farasin bihi faqul innahu sakbun falam tudhami
kānat lahu ghurratun taḥjīlahu dhakarū ṭalqa l-yadayni kumayta l-lawni fāftahimi
wardun wadhū limmatin mirwāḥu thumma mulā wiḥun wasirḥānu maʿ mandūbihi l-khadhimi
baḥrun najībun wayaʿbūbun wamurtajilun yaʿsūbun ḍ-ḍarsu qad zādūhu kāḍḍarimi
shaḥḥā laḥīfun mina l-maʿdūdi murtajizun fafī l-mawāhibi dhikru l-julli lā tahimi
wamā ʿalayhi ttifāqun sabḥatun ẓaribun sakbun wamurtajizun thumma l-lizāza simi
lahu thalāthatu afrāsin wamā ʿulimat asmā'uhā fālmunāwī qāla dhā gh-tanimi
wasarjuhu kāna min līfin ulīna famā aḥabbahu l-khayla yā bushrá limustalimi
wafiḍḍatun duldulun ʿaddu l-bighāli lahu wamā akhū aylatin yuhdīhi lilkarami
aʿṭāhu aṣḥamatun ukhrá kadhalika kisrá thumma min dūmatin ukhrá falā tahimi
waqīla mā qīla min kisrá falaysa lahu thabtun kamā qīla ʿinda l-jillati l-'umami
amā ʿufayrun wayaʿfūrun faqīla humā murādifān ḥimāra l-muṣṭafá l-ʿalami
ḥimāru saʿdin famaʿdūdun lahu ʿadadan wa rābiʿun ʿudda ayḍan ʿinda baʿḍihimi
qaṣwā'u ʿaḍbāu jadʿā'u waqīla fadhī tarādafat nūqu khayri l-khalqi dhī l-qadami
waqīla ʿaḍbā'u jadʿā'un liwāḥidatin qaṣwā liwāḥidatin yā likhtilāfihimi
jimāluhu thaʿlabun qul hakadhā jamalun lilbadri aḥmaru khayri l-khalqi kullihimi
waḥāza muktasaban fī anfihi buratun min fiḍḍatin yawma badrin min abī l-ḥakami
mina l-liqāḥi lahu haylun wakāna lahu kāfun yurāḥu ilayhi dūna muttahami
biqirbatayni ʿaẓīmatayni min labanin fī kulli laylin wajalla l-lahu dhū l-ḥikami
wa'inna fīhā ghazīrātin yufarriquhā ʿalá n-nisā'i rasūlu l-ʿurbi wālʿajami
minhā kamā jā'anā l-ḥannā'u thumma ʿurayyisu l-bughūmu wasamrā'un bifatḥihimi
wabasrdatun marwatun saʿdīyatun ḥifarun yusayratun muhratun rayyā bimaddihimi
shaqrā'u ṣahbā'u wālghaḍbā'u marra lahā kamithli qaṣwā wajadʿā dhikru khulfihimi
lahu manā'iḥu tarʿá hunna dāyatuhu tarūḥu fī kulli laylin dūna muttahami
ʿalá l-buyūti l-latī l-hādī yadūru bihā minhā l-latī kh-taṣṣahā shurban walam yulami
bighawthatin duʿiyat aw ghaythatin yamanun shātun lahu qamarun ʿuddat falā tahimi
aṭlālu aṭrāfu suqyā zamzamun barakun waʿajratun warshatun fāqra' bimunʿajimi
waqad ḥawá mi'atan shātan walaysa lahā zaydun ʿalá l-ʿadadi l-maḥdūdi min ghanami
wayadhbaḥu sh-shāta rāʿīhā idhā wulidat makānahā bahmatun min dūnimā wadhami
wamā atānā q-tinā'u l-muṣṭafá baqaran lakin muḍaḥḥin bihā ʿan ahlihi l-ḥarami
wa'abyaḍa d-dīki ḥāza l-badru murshidunā waʿindahu kāna kulla l-layli lam yarimi
ina s-suyūfa fama'thuwurun kadhā l-qulaʿī wamikhdhamun ʿaḍbun l-battāru kulla kami
ḥatfun rasūbun qaḍībun dhū l-fiqāri wazid ṣamṣāmatan wāftaḥan ṣādayhi tastaqimi
ḍarsu l-ḥimāri wadhū nūnin kadhāka kashū ḥun kāṣṣabūri biwaznin murtaḍan karami
ʿilāqatan ḥilqatan min fiḍḍatin waqabīʿatan waqā'imatan fī dhī l-fiqāri simi
fafiḍḍatun khirnaqun batrā'u saʿdīyatun dhātu l-fuḍūli ḥawāshin wālwishāḥu numī
sabʿu d-durūʿi l-lawātī kāna yalbasuhā khayru l-barīyati fī ḥarbin wamultaṭami
hā'u l-qisīyi katūmun wāssadādu waṣafrā'un wa zawrā'u rawḥā'un falilmiʿami
waqīla wāwun faʿaddid shawḥaṭan litará ṣidqa l-maqāli falam tartab walam tahimi
wasammi nabla nabīyi l-lahi mūtaṣilan wālwāwu ʿinda qurayshin ghayru munṣarimi
wajaʿbatun sammihā l-kāfūra minṭaqatun mina l-'adīmi likhayri l-khalqi kullihimi
ibzīmuhā ṭarfuhā sāmun lahā ḥilaqun min fiḍḍatin ʿadduhā jīmun bilā wadhami
muthwin wamuthnan kadhāka l-’ākhirāni lahu mina r-rimāḥi wafīhā khulfu kutbihimi
ina z-zalūqa wadhā t-timthāli maʿ futaqin atrāsuhu rabbi hadhā l-ʿabdu dhū l-jurami
ḥirābuhu nabʿatun bayḍā'u thumma ṣaghīratun biʿanzata tudʿá dūna muttahami
lahā yuṣallī idhā mā kāna fī safarin wālmahra wānnamra zid fīhā falā tadhumi
wamiḥjanun ṭūluhā qadru dh-dhirāʿi lahu yamshī bihi yuddaʿá dhaqnan bilā wahami
kadhā l-qaḍību l-ladhī qad dāwala l-khulafā min shawḥaṭin sammihi l-mamshūqa lam taḍimi
wakāna min ḥawzi khayri l-khalqi mikhṣaratun kāna s-muhā sh-tāʿa bilʿurjūni fāḥtakimi
muwashshaḥun fasabūghun khūdhatāni lahu wamighfarun min ḥadīdin linnabī l-mi'ami
ina l-mughītha warayyānan wamughtasalan qad jā mina ṣ-ṣufri aqdāḥun lidhī l-karami
qadḥu z-zujāji waʿaydānin wamin ḥajarin tawrun duʿī mikhḍaban ʿaddid bihi taqumi
wamudhunun mikhḍabun qad kāna min shabahin muḍabbaban muḥkaman min fiḍḍatin aqimi
kamā lahu rakwatun tudʿá biṣādiratin warabʿatan jāʿilan fīhā akhū l-himami
mushṭan siwākan wamir’ātan wamukḥulatan ʿaddid walā tansa fī t-taʿdādi biljalami
sammi l-mudillata mir’āta n-nabīyi kamā miqrāḍuhu jāmiʿan tadʿū falam taṣimi
waqaṣʿatun thumma ṣāʿun mudduhu waqaṭīfatun sarīrun firāshun kāna min adami
lahu s-sarīra qada ahdá asʿadu bnu zurā ratin yanāmu ʿalayhi l-qalbu lam yanami
ṣallaw ʿalayhi ʿalá dhāka s-sarīri riḍan kamā bihi rafaʿū ṣ-ṣiddīqa fī ghumami
wahakadhā ʿumarun wānnāsu baʿdahumu tabarrukan dāwalū fī ḥamli maytihimi
alwāḥuhu kāna ʿabdu l-lahi shāriyahā biqadri arbaʿati l-’ālāfi fāghtanimi
wakāna qad bīʿa fī matrūki ʿā'ishatin īyāhu mallakahā l-hādī ilá l-karami
waqaʿbuhu saʿatan yudʿá bighayri miran waʿillatu l-kulli tabdū ʿinda muftahimi
wasammi qaṣʿatahu l-gharrā'a fī ḥilaqin dālin wayaḥmiluhā dālun mina l-ʿutumi
lahu jibābun abun fī l-ḥarbi yalbasuhā min fiḍḍatin waḥadīdin ḥā'izu l-khatami
muḥammadun naqshu khātāmi n-nabīyi rasū lu l-lahi sayyidinā l-munjī mina n-niqami
wabaʿḍu khātāmihi fālfiṣṣu minhu wabaʿḍun fiṣṣuhu min ʿaqīqin bilʿulūmi qumi
fatāratan biyamīnin tāratan biyasā rin jāʿilan fiṣṣahu fī kaffihi l-karami
min baʿdu fī yadi ṣiddīqin kadhā ʿumarun kadhāka ʿuthmānu fī tadāwulin karami
aw kāna bīra arīsin sāqiṭan wayuqā lu ḍāʿa fī yawmi dārin dhāka lam yaqumi
kadhāka khuffānu kānā sādhajayni ʿimā matun saḥāban tusammá lilhudá l-khiḍami
min bayni aktāfihi qad kāna murkhiyahā mā ṣaḥḥa fīhā ḥadīthun jā mina l-qudumi
fī ẓāhirin qadruhā yā adhruʿin thiqatī aw fawqahā biyasīrin ʿinda dhī l-ḥikami
qalānisun ṣaghurat birra'si lāṭi'atun saḥābu yalbasuhā min fawqu lā tahimi
wadhātu l-a’ādhāni ayḍan kāna yalbasuhā mina l-ḥurūbi hizabru l-ghīli wāl'ujumi
amā ṭ-ṭiwālu fabaʿda l-badri qad ḥadathat ayyāma sayyidinā l-manṣūri dhī l-karami
qāla n-nabīyu dhawū l-'islāmi mayzuhumu ʿalá l-qalāsī ʿ-timāmun qawlahu r-tasimi
dūna l-qalānīsi yaʿtammu n-nabī wabihā wadhū l-ttaqallusi ʿanhā l-barru lam yahimi
waqul lahu rāyatun tudʿá l-ʿuqāba liwā un sammihi l-ḥamda waṣfa l-ḥaqqi tattasimi
kadhā lahu rāyatun bayḍā'u qad duʿiyat bizīnatin ʿudda ṣafrā'an falam tudhami
kamā lahu n-naʿlu biṣṣafrā'i qad duʿiyat wasammi fisṭāṭahu bilkinni tastaqimi
ʿdid ridan burdatan kānat yamāniyatan fī jumʿatin thumma fī l-ʿīdayni talta'imi
ʿimāmatun kānati s-sawdā'a yalbasu fī l-ʿīdayni murkhiyahā min khalfihi f-tahimi
bayḍā wasawdā waṣafrā'un yulābisuhā lakinnamā l-'aktharu l-bayḍā'u fī l-ghimami
aqallu ʿadhbatihā dālu l-'aṣābiʿi qul ajalluhā fadhirāʿun dūnamā ghumami
ʿaddid ridan aḥḍaran qad kāna dāwalahu aḥbābuhu l-khulafā min baʿdi quṭbihimi
waḥāza malḥafatan kānat muwarrasatan ʿalayhi ṣalli ṣalātan rabbi kāddiyami
lahu shiʿārun dithārun wālqamīṣu kamā lahu s-sarāwīlu fī l-lubsi l-khilāfu numī
amā sh-shirā faṣaḥīḥun fī ṣ-ṣudūri salā mā rabbinā l-khāliqi l-'aʿlá ʿalá l-ḥakami
mimmā n-nabī ḥ-tāzahu l-mindīlu yamsaḥu minhu ṭalʿatan nūruhā aʿlá mina l-jalami
muzaynatun awwalan lilbadri qad wafadū fī ʿāmi khamsin kadhā saʿdu b-ni bakrihimi
fī rajabin wajudhāmun wāfidūna biʿā mi sabʿatin wa'abū mūsá bi'ithrihimi
kadhāka dawsun sulaymun wāfidūna lahu fī ḥā wathaʿlabatun qul fī jumūʿihimi
thamālatun thumma ḥaddānun bihā wabiʿā mi tisʿatin wafdu hamdānin ʿalá l-ʿalami
ina l-wufūda biʿāmi t-tisʿi aktharuhā lidhāka summiya ʿāma l-wafdi fāʿtazimi
kadhā banū d-dāri thumma fīhi fī ṣafarin ʿudhratu jā'ū balīyun ḥimyarun bihimi
fī ʿāshirin wafdu khawlānin wakindatu thumma ghāmidun thumma ghassānun dhawū l-karami
kadhāka wafdu r-rahāwīyīna thummata najrānun ṣudā thumma azdun fī q-tifā'ihimi
kadhā salāmānu baṭnun min quḍāʿata sabʿatun ḥabību bni ʿamrinw fīhimu r-tasimi
kadhā bajīlatu ḥaḍramawtu maʿ nakhaʿin wawafdu ḥārithin b-ni kaʿbin sh-shahimi
waminhumu murratun ʿabsun kadhā asadun ʿuṭāridun jā'a wafdan maʿ tamīmihimi
bāhilatun jaʿdatun fazāratun waʿaqīlun maʿ kinānata ʿabdun ashjaʿu gh-tanimi
wafdu laqīṭin wabakrin baʿdahu qudadun wafdu kilābin thaqīfin ʿabdi qaysihimi
wafdu ru'āsin waʿāmirin hilāla waʿansin waqushayri b-ni kaʿbin dūna muttahami
wawafdu taghlaba baʿḍun muslimun wanaṣā rá qurrirū khayra iqrārin bidīnihimi
lakin ʿalá jizyatin wamanʿi wuldihimu an yuṣbaghū ṣibghatan kaṣabghi aṣlihimi
muḥāribun ʿāma ʿashrin wāfidūna lahu waṭāriqun famajāzun ʿadduhu bihimi
idh jā'a yamtāru min tamri l-madīnati qul baʿīrahu b-tāʿahu l-mukhtāru min karami
banū ḥanīfata minhum wāfidū yamanin minhum yamānin tujībun ʿudda wāftahimi
waṭayyi'un thumma jayshānun lahu wafadū kalbun faʿudda khushaynan maʿ murādihimi
wahakadhā ṣadifun qul khathʿamun wafadū saʿdu l-ʿashīrati min khayri l-wufūdi numī
kadhāka azdu ʿumānin maʿ zubayda wa'aslamun kadhā bāriqun wābna l-ḥumaydi simi
saʿdu hudhaymin wajarmun wāfidun wakadhā bahrā'u mahrata wāljuʿfī biḍammihimi
juhaynatun nakhaʿun ay thānīan fabihi tamma l-wufūdu ʿalá khayri l-wará l-ʿalami
wadhāka fī ʿāmi iḥdá ʿashratin ẓafirū kulla l-muná biwujūdi l-'amni wāssalami
wafdu s-sibāʿi dhi'ābin ghābatan dhakarū wadhāka yunkiruhu jamʿun mina l-'umami
wālittifāqu bi'anna l-jinna qad wafadū idh fī l-kitābi atānā dūnamā wahami
ḥadhawtu ḥadhwa l-ʿirāqī l-barri sayyidinā fī kulli mā jā'a fī dhā l-faṣli min kalimi
yā rabbi man aslamū minhum wamā nakathū faʿuddanī fīhimu yā wāsiʿa r-ruḥumi
waman ʿalá sunnati l-hādī wasīratihi yaqfū wayastannu bil'ifḍāli wālkarami
lilahi darru mujībin qāla sā'ilahu inna r-rasūla biqadri l-mursali ḥ-takimi
wakāna fakhman ḥabību l-lahi murshidunā mufakhkhaman ghāyata t-tafkhīmi dhā l-ʿiṣami
wawajhu khayru l-wará l-mukhtāri min muḍarin mina t-tala'lu'i badrun fī dujá ẓ-ẓulami
ka'annamā sh-shamsu tajrī fawqa ṣafḥatihi wafī l-'asirrati yajrī rawnaqu l-ʿiẓami
qalīlu tadwyri wajhin laysa kalthamatun wāṭṭūlu fī l-wajhi yā waṣṣāfata s-siyami
min nūri ʿirnīnihi qad ẓanna nāẓiruhu idhā taʿajjala an qad ḥāzi min shamami
yará biẓalmā'a nūru l-ʿālamīna kamā ʿalá ḍiyā'in yará ṣaddiq walā taghimi
badrun aṭīṭu s-samā qad kāna yasmaʿuhu aw qāla aṭṭat bidhā ḥaddith walā takhimi
ṣaltu l-jabīni walā tansub lahu qaranan azajju ahdabu aqná ablaju l-ḥakami
wa'anjalun adʿaju l-ʿaynayni akḥalu qul asīlu khaddayni ʿarqu l-wajhi kāttuwami
ka'anna fī khaddihi mā'a dh-dhuhūbi jará mulāḥikan wajhahu l-judrānu wā alamī
warīḥuhu laysa rīḥu l-miski yushbihuhu ka'annamā fiḍḍatun ʿunqun lidhī l-qudumi
wajullu naẓri n-nabī l-hādī mulāḥaẓatun ʿalayhi khayru salāmin ṭayyibin karami
qul khāfiḍu ṭ-ṭarfi lilghabrā'i manẓaruhu aʿlá mina n-naẓri liljarbā'i min ḥashami
wadhū tawāṣuli aḥzānin wadā'imu fikrin ṣadruhu mirjalun qad fāza min sadami
mā mithlu rīqi nabīyi l-lahi min ʿiṭarin qad kāna ashnaba ḍakhma r-ra'si wāljumami
ṭawīlu masrubatin fī shaʿrihi rajalun waraḥbu rāḥin wa shathnu l-kaffi wālqadami
walā l-ḥarīru walā d-dībāju alyanu min kaffi r-rasūli ṭawīli z-zandi lā taṣimi
wa'abyaḍan mushraban qad kāna dhā falajin wakāna rabʿata qaddin aw ḍalīʿa fami
yā wāṣifan fānfi taṭhīman kadhā mahaqun wahakadhā udmatun lā sh-shakla tuḥtarami
yubdī sanā l-barqi aw ḥabba l-ghamāmi idhā mā f-tarra akrim bihādī l-khalqi lil'umami
idhā takallama rī'a n-nūru yakhruju min bayni th-thanāyā wamā fī l-qawli min wadhami
tabassumun jullu ḍiḥki l-badri sayyidinā tabdū nawājidhuhu fī ḍ-ḍiḥki min umami
wamā tajarrada min khayri l-barīyati an warun wa'ajradu raḥbu ṣ-ṣadri lil'umami
wakāna aʿlá mina l-marbūʿi aʿẓama min mushadhdhabi azhara l-'alwāni fāftahimi
sawā'u baṭnin waṣadrin rabbi khāliqanā ʿalayhi khayru salāmin murtaḍan adimi
min bayni katfayhi khātāmu n-nubūwati ʿinda nāghiḍi l-katifi l-yusrá bilā wahami
waḥawlahu shaʿarātu yā lanāẓirihi fīhi kh-tilāfun kathīrun ghayru munkatimi
hal zirru ḥajlata aw bīḍu l-ḥamāmati aw jamʿun faqul fawqahu l-khīlānu lam tahimi
yazūlu khayru l-wará l-mukhtāru shāfiʿunā taqalluʿan mithla jārī l-mā'i munsajimi
ka'annahu in mashá yanḥaṭṭu min ṣababin walā yurá atharun fī s-sahli lilqadami
yamshī t-takaffu'a hawnan wahwa ṭā'ilu man māshá walaw kāna mimman liṭṭiwāli numī
manhūsu kaʿbin masīḥu r-rijli mishyatuhu dharīʿatun hakadhā yamshī dhawū l-himami
fī akhmaṣay muqtafin hādin hudan wazarin khayru l-barīyati khumṣānun walam yaṣimi
wa'innahu bijamīʿi l-jismi multafitun walā yulawwī biʿunqin mithla dhī l-faghami
walaysa fī ra'si hādīnā waliḥyatihi ʿishrūna bayḍā'a idh mā jī'a bishshabimi
ḥawá l-kathāthata fī t-taḥqīqi liḥyatuhu wakāna yakhḍibu bilḥinnā'i wālkatami
ina l-ladhī kāna bayna l-mankibayni baʿīdun innahu kāna sabṭa l-ʿaṣbi fāstaqimi
wakāni sā'ila aṭrāfin waḍaḥma karā dīsin jalīla mushāshin ajwada n-nasami
ʿablu dh-dhirāʿayni wālʿaḍdayni shabḥuhumā qul jawharu l-ḥusni fīhi ghayru munqasimi
waman ra’āhu mufājātan yahābu bihi ammā mukhāliṭuhu fāzzā'idu r-rakhami
wabādinun fī ʿ-tidāli l-khalqi makhbaruhu mar’āhu yashhadu mā qad ḥāza min karami
in qulta aṭnabta fī t-tawṣīfi qultu naʿam kullu l-maqāmi lahu ḥaqun falā taḍimi
wawājibun ṭāʿatu l-hādī maḥabbatuhu kadhā t-tibāʿu l-ladhī ya'tī mina l-'umami
lahā l-ʿalāmātu qālū inna aʿẓamahā s-tiʿmālu sunnatihi min jumlati l-'imami
walaysa nafʿun ʿalá ḥubbin bilā ʿamalin watābiʿan sunnata l-mukhtāri taghtanimi
wakathratu sh-shawqi fī luqyā lisayyidinā mina l-ʿalāmāti hab lī dhāka dhā l-'umami
wakathru dhikrin ṣalātin thumma nuṣratu dīnihi takhalluqu mā qad jā'a min shiyami
taʿẓīmuhu wāltidhādhun ḥīna tadhkuruhu ḥubbu l-qurāni wa'aṣḥābin lahu karami
ina l-qurāna huwa l-mīzānu taʿrifu minhu mā ḥawayta mina l-'ashwāqi wāssadami
yā man yurīdu jināna l-khuldi yaskunuhā faqaddiman ṭalaba l-miftāḥi tuḥtarami
wālmuʿjizātu lahu taʿdāduhā ʿabathun miʿshāru l-aʿshāri lam yudrak walam yusami
jīmu l-'ulūfi lihādī l-khalqi muʿjizatan ammā l-qurānu faqālū fīhi ʿaddu lami
kafá l-qurānu l-ladhī yaghdū bihi l-fuṣaḥā'u l-lusnu fī bakamin wālbahti wāṣṣamami
wa'uḥkimat fuṣṣilat ’āyātuhu kalimā tuhu bihi ḥārati l-'aḥlāmu lishshuhumi
wakāna khulqa nabīyi l-lahi laysa lahu khulqun siwāhu fafāqa l-kulla fī l-karami
wujūhu iʿjāzihi aʿyat muʿāriḍahu wa'amru l-iʿjāzifātūjā mina l-ḥakami
ina l-mamāta wamaḥyā l-badri marḥamatun amātanā l-lahu fī hadyi r-riḍá l-karami
tubānu aʿmālunā yawma l-khamīsi lahu wayawma l-ithnayni fī s-tighfāri dhī l-jurami
lahu mina l-muʿjizāti l-ghurri jumlatu mā lil'anbiyā bikhtiṣāṣi l-faḍli wālwadhami
taslīmu l-aḥjāri wāl'ashjāri shāhidatan munqādatan kānqiyādi sh-shamsi wāẓẓalami
ina l-mughayyiba kālmashhūdi yukhbiruhu ka'amri ʿuthmāna wāl'iṣlāḥi lil'umami
kadhā atá shajarun lilbarri yasturuhu yārabbi hab lī s-titāran ghayra munfaṣimi
ibrā'u l-asqāmi wāl’ālāmi mūjiʿatan iḥyā'u l-amwāti maʿ ibrā'i dhī l-lamami
taqlību l-āʿyāni taklīmu l-bahā'imi takthīru l-qalīli shifā'u l-'akmahi s-sadimi
wasal muʿāwiyata bna th-thawri daʿwatahu awi l-ḥalīmata wāl'amthāla tanfaḥimi
ta'mīnu uskuffatin tasbīḥu aṭʿimatin shakwá l-baʿīri washakwá ṭ-ṭayri lilʿalami
minhā i'timāru ghamāmin min ishāratihi fī s-saqyi wa ṣ-ṣaḥwi wāl'isqāṭu liṣṣanami
mā farra ʿanhu wuḥūshun bal tuwālifuhu wālmilḥu ʿadhbun furātun laysa bissudumi
ina l-jamādāti wālʿajmā'a mufṣiḥatun bimā bihi l-fuṣaḥā'u l-lusni fī l-bakami
wayashhadu ḍ-ḍabbu maʿ dhi'bin risālatahu kaẓabyatin fī wathāqi l-qāniṣi l-ʿarimi
ina l-ḥaṣá sabbaḥat fī kaffihi wabiqabḍatin katā'ibu farrū sharra munhazami
wahakadhā nāqatun addat shahādatahā lirabbihā ʿinda hādī l-khalqi lilḥakami
qālat waqad shahidat mā kāna sāriqahā bil innahā milkuhu ḥaqqan falam tulami
wafāḥa ʿutbatu rīḥan massa rāḥatihi yaḍūʿu minhu sh-shadhā wālmisku fī sh-shamami
waḥanna jidhʿun ḥanīna th-thukli dhā walahin wasājidun jamalun lilbadri kālghanami
lawlam yanal ḍamma hādīnā ladāma lahu ḥanīnuhu dā'iman lilbaʿthi wālquḥami
tajallabat shūwalun wāshshātu mukhbiratun summan walam yalqa idh sammá mina l-'alami
dhū n-nūri fī sawṭihi yabdū lahum ʿajabun aʿnī ṭufayla bna ʿamrin wa binnabī ʿ-taṣimi
wa'inna fī l-badri ahla n-nadwati ṣ-ṭalamū man massahu t-turbu minhum ghayru dhī salami
qabla l-liqā bayyana l-hādī maṣāriʿahum ḥaddithhu ʿan ʿumara l-fārūqi dhī l-ḥurami
lilahi yawmun bihi l-'islāmu mushtahirun waʿammuhu kāna fī l-'infāqi dhā sadami
wamā daʿā qaṭṭu illā kāna daʿwatuhu mujābatan dūna tardīdin walā ʿatami
wamā'u yabsāna idh sammá n-nabīyu bihi naʿmāna ʿadhbun furātun ṭayyibu ṭ-ṭuʿami
maṣṣu l-lisāni bihi l-ʿaṭshānu nāla riwan wānzāḥa bardun waḥarrun ʿan ʿalīyihimi
wa'innamā ruḍaʿā'u l-badri fāṭimatin bitaflatin lahumu s-taghnaw ʿani l-ghudhami
wadhāka fī yawmi ʿāshūrā'a yā lahumu bitaflatin khallatan saddat biyawmihimi
wamin anāmilihi nabʿu l-miyāhi waqul fī kaffihi shabiʿa l-’ālāfu min ṭuʿami
rukūbu faḥlin ʿarūḍin qāṭiʿin ṭuruqan min muʿjizāti nabīyin khīrati l-'umami
aʿṭá qatādata ʿurjūnan yuḍī'u lahu fī baytihi ḍāriba sh-shayṭāni dhā hazami
wafī b-ni bishrin usaydi bni l-ḥuḍayri muṣaghghirayni amrun ʿajībun khāriqu d-dijami
wasal rukānata idh mā kāna ṣāraʿahu bal sal abā l-'aswadi l-jumḥīya tastalimi
aw kayfa kāna warabbī l-lahu fī uḥudin shujāʿatu l-muṣṭafá liljayshi dhā shamami
aw sal ubayyan idhā lāqāhu muʿtaliqan ʿalayhi burthunu laythin ḍayghamin ḥuṭami
abū hurayrata sā'il minhu qabḍatahu minhā qada n-faqa aḥqāban mina l-hanami
lilahi shaṭrun ʿalá riffin liʿā'ishatin bihi n-tafá rīḥu afwāhin mina l-laḥami
lahu yusabbiḥu rummānun kadhā ʿinabun atá bihi r-rūḥu lilmabʿūthi fī saqami
ʿukāshatun jadhluhu ṣāra l-ḥusāma ṭawīla qāmatin yuddaʿá ʿawnan limultaṭimi
walam yazal fī qitāli l-kāfirīna bihi ḥattá yakūna shahīdan fī qitālihimi
minhu b-nu jaḥshin ḥawá l-ʿurjūna fī uḥudin faʿāda sayfan ḥadīdan ghayra muktahimi
kāna t-tawāruthu aw bāʿūhu fī dhahabin mina l-'amīri bughā t-turkī limuʿtaṣimi
waḥāza mā ḥāza lakin lā yumāthilu min tawāḍuʿin wakhushūʿi l-qalbi wārratami
min kulli waṣfin ḥamīdin ḥāza afʿala tafḍīlin rajā'u l-barāyā yawma muzdaḥami
wakāna ashjaʿa askhá n-nāsi aḥsanahum khalqan wakhulqan wakhayra l-ḥizbi wāl'umami
mā kāna taḥtāju tabyīnan shajāʿatuhu ahla l-madīnati sā'il layla fazʿihimi
kānū idhā ḥ-marra ba'sun yattaqūna bihi waqad badat fī ḥunaynin ghāyatu l-qudumi
wa'alyanu n-nāsi qālū lam yakun abadan bayna ṣ-ṣaḥābati dhā maddin mina l-qadami
mujība daʿwati mamlūkin warākiban l-ḥimāra ʿā'ida dhī l-'awjāʿi wāssaqami
wamā yujību shafīʿu l-khalqi dāʿiyahu illā bilabbayka fī tarḥībihi l-jamami
imā ʿabīdun waṣibyānun yusallimuhum mumāziḥun ghayru ḥaqqin mā ilayhi numī
mulāzimu l-jūʿi bil'aḥjāri muntaṣiran lakinna dhalika mā qad kāna min yatami
ina ṭ-ṭaʿāmayni mā fī baṭnihi j-tamaʿā walam yaku qaṭṭu shabʿānan mina ṭ-ṭuʿami
lahu thalāthūna yawman mā yadhūqu siwá mā kāna ibṭu bilālin ḍamma min ṭuʿami
yamurru shahrun awi sh-shahrāni min zamanin walam tara l-ʿayna fī l-'abyāti min ḥadami
mā kāna ya'kulu khayru l-khalqi munfaridan li'anna dhalika khīmu n-niksi wālbarami
ina l-ghadā waʿashā l-hādī ʿalá ḍafafin ay kathrati l-'aydi lam yūṣaf mina s-sa'ami
wālkaffu mā ḍarabat unsan walā dhakaran mā khādiman ʿāba min ʿaybin walam yalumi
wakullu shay'in yaqūlu l-lahu fāʿiluhu lawlam yasha' dhāka mā qad kāna min ʿadami
mā kāna muntaqiman linnafsi muḥtajiban ammā ṭ-ṭaʿāmu falam yumdaḥ walam yaṣimi
waṭāḥinun ḥālibun wāshshāta muʿtaqilun muwākilun khāṣifun naʿlan mina l-khadami
qul dā'imu l-bishri sahlu l-khulqi laynu janā ḥin laysa faẓẓan ghalīẓa l-qalbi fī l-'umami
walā ṣakhūbin wafaḥḥāshin walā mutafaḥḥishin walaysa biʿayyābin kadhī l-qazami
laysa n-nabīyu bimazzāḥin waqul huwa fī baʿḍi l-'aḥāyīni fī ta'nīsi jamʿihimi
fī nuskhatin laysa maddāḥan walaysa mushā ḥan khaffifi l-ḥā'a min waznin falam tulami
qul hakadhā sīratu l-mukhtāri sayyidinā wadhā ḥadīthun ʿalīyun ʿan ʿalīyihimi
walaysa khayru l-wará yajzī bisayyi'atin yaʿfū wayaṣfaḥu ṣafḥan ʿan musī'ihimi
jammu l-ḥayā'i famā l-ʿadhrā'u tudrikuhu fī ḥidhrihā wa'umūru l-barri fī z-zamami
yaruddu man ammahu min ḥājatin biluhan kamā sh-tahá aw bimaysūrin mina l-kalimi
wayatruku n-nafsa min jīmi l-khiḍāli mirā mā laysa yaʿnī wa'ikthārin mina n-niʿami
walā yadhummu ʿarīban lā yuʿayyibuhu kadhāka ʿawratahu l-mukhtāru lam yarumi
wakullu mālam yakun yarjū th-thawāba bihi yūlīhi ṣumtan waṣafḥan ayyamā shamami
ḥaythu n-tahá majlisun kāna l-julūsu lahu lam yajlisanna bighayri dh-dhikri lam yaqumi
wakāna ya'muru hadhā man yujālisuhu yassir lanā iswatan yā rabbi fī l-'imami
ḥilmun waṣabrun ḥayā'un wāl'amānatu majlisu l-karīmi warafʿu ṣ-ṣawti fīhi ḥumī
walam yaqūmū lahu idh jā'a ʿilmahumu karāhata l-muṣṭafá t-tashbīha bilʿajami
waman atāhu hadāyā qul yukāfi'uhu fakun bihi ’āsīan fī l-fiʿli wāshshiyami
kalāmuhu fabidhikri l-lahi muftatiḥun kadhāka yakhtimuhu yā ṭība mukhtatami
idhā tatabbaʿta ’āyāti n-nabīyi tará bi'annahu fī siwá l-khayrāti lam yuṭami
aʿdadtu ḥubba rasūli l-lahi maḥsharatī likay yulāqiyanī fī awwali ẓ-ẓalami
kamā wahabta lanā tartība sīratihi fahab lanā l-iqtidā yā hādiya t-tahimi
waqad tawassaltu yā raḥmānu yā thiqatī yā mughnīan dāfiʿa l-'awzāri wānniqami
rabbī bi'ansmā'ika l-ḥusná wa'aʿẓamihā wālānbiyā'i wawusṭá silki naẓmihimi
muḥammadun aḥmadu l-māḥī waḥāshirunā nabīyu marḥamatin tawbin wamultaḥami
thumma l-muqaffá bishaddi l-fā'i qad ḍabaṭū wakasrihā wasukūni l-yā bikutbihimi
wālʿāqibu l-muqtafī ’āthāra man sabaqū min anbiyā'a warusli l-lahi kullihimi
zāda l-mawāhibu asmā'an warattabahā ʿalá l-ḥurūfi ilá l-yā muntahá l-kalimi
waʿāma uhdi'a muḥtāzan ʿalá jalalin daʿāhu fī ṣafarin mawlāhu lilkarami
wākhtāra mawlāhu idh mā l-lahu khayyarahu ʿani z-zakhārifi dhā zuhdin wadhā shamami
ḥawá yadan ʿinda baʿḍin fī ta'ahhubihi ḥāna r-raḥīlu lahu fī yawmihi l-ʿalami
fī yawmi mawlidihi fī bayti ʿā'ishatin qabla z-zawāli bishahri l-mawlidi l-ʿaẓim
lilaylatin qīla aw laylatayni qad khalatā waqīla fī ḥubbihi fābḥath walā tanami
yawma th-thulāthā'i qad qīla l-'ufūlu lahu ḥissan laqad ṭāba fī bad'in wamukhtatami
fī l-qawli l-āshhari anna d-dafna laylata ar biʿā'a fī jawfi laylin fādri wāḥtakimi
min dahshatin akhkharū dafna n-nabīyi walishtighālihim man yuwallī kulla amrihimi
ina ṣ-ṣalāta wamamlūkan la’ākhiru mā awṣá bihi l-muṣṭafá fī ḥālati l-'alami
jalāla rabbin rafīʿin kāna ’ākhiru mā takallama l-mujtabá min aḥsani l-kalimi
bal qāla mā qāla min ʿindi l-ḥalīmati ’ā khira r-raḍāʿi l-bukhārī rāʿi taftahimi
wakāna ukhrisa ʿuthmānun wa'ukhbila fā rūqun wa'uqʿida laythu l-buhmi wāṣṣimami
wa'urjifa n-nāsu wāl'aḥlāmu dhāhilatun lawlā l-ʿatīqu lamāta n-nāsu bilghumami
qad kāna idh dhāka fī sunḥin waʿāliyatin wajā'ahu n-naʿyu dhā ḥuznin wadhā sajami
jathā yuqabbiluhu yabkī yaqūlu lahu qad ṭibta yā badru fī ḥālayka wā sadamī
ina l-jamādāti kādat minhu ṣādiʿatan fakayfa man ’āmanū bi l-lahi rabbihimi
ina l-jināna ʿalá t-tazyīni yawma qudū mi rūḥihi tārika d-dunyā ʿalá ẓ-ẓulami
wabaʿda mā bāyaʿū ṣ-ṣiddīqa qad ʿazamū ʿalá jahāzi rasūlin muhtadin raḥimi
fī l-ghusli wāddafni kāna l-khulfu yā lahumu ʿalá firāqi ḥabībin fāriji l-himami
waḥaydarun ghusluhu wālin yuqallibuhu l-ʿabbāsu wābnāhu faḍlun thanni bilquthami
yaṣubbu mā'an ʿalá l-hādī usāmatu maʿ shaqrāna wāl'awsu maʿdūdun bijamʿihimi
qarāḥun s-sidru kāfūrun bihā ghasalū wālmā'u min bi'ri gharsin aṭyabi s-sanimi
wakaffanūhu bibīḍin qul yamāniyatin wānfi l-ʿamāmata wāttaqmīṣa fī l-ghumami
wakāna yudraju fī l-'akfāni thumma humu ṣallaw ʿalá l-badri afdhādhan bilā umami
fī l-qabri anzalahu l-ghussālu awsuhumu wa'aṭbaqū l-labināti t-tisʿa fī r-rajami
wafīhi afrasha ḥamrā'a l-qaṭīfati shuqrānun wamā wāfaqa sh-shuqrānu min arimi
waqīla qad akhrajūhā baʿdu ulḥida qabru l-muṣṭafá khayra ilḥādin mina l-khidami
wābnu l-ḥamāmati rashsha l-qabra yabda'u min wijāhati r-ra'si thumma l-qalbu dhū ḍ-ḍarami
yā qāḍīan bi'ufūli l-badri muntahīan ʿalayhi ṣalli wahab lī khayra mukhtatami
yā man atamma khilāṣī fā'iqan ḍuraran qad zayyanat sīratan min khīrati n-nuẓumi
atmim lanā nūranā wāghfir jarā'imanā taqḍī ḥawā'ijanā yā wāsiʿa r-ruḥumi
ḥamdan yuwāfī bi'anʿāmin lanā wafurat lirabbinā wayukāfī z-zayda min niʿami
wasayyi'a l-jalbi qad ji'nā walaysa lanā mina t-tasawwuqi buddun wāsiʿa l-karami
wadhākumu jamratun fī l-qalbi muḥriqatun lakinna lā taqnaṭū tuṭfī mina l-ḥadami
fa'aʿṭinā fī l-liqā mā ʿ-tīda minka mina l-ghufrāni wālʿafwi wāl'iʿḍā'i ʿan jurami

azká ṣalātin wataslīmin zará ʿiṭaran ʿalá l-ḥabībi ṣ-ṣafīyi ṭ-ṭāhiri l-miʿami
mā ḥanna ḥibbun ilá luqyā l-ḥabībi wamā yaqfū ʿalá sīrati l-maḥbūbi wālqadami
wāl’āli wāṣṣaḥbi aṣḥābi l-hudá l-ʿulamā qubūri asrārihi lil'ummati n-nujumi
rabbī bihi wabihim abghī s-sulūka ilá ṭarīqati r-rushdi wālkhayrāti wālʿiṣami
wāṣbub ʿalaynā buḥūra l-khayri wālkarami l-ʿamīmi shīʿatanā yā malja'a z-za'imi
